# Objetivo

**Estado:** version principal en desarrollo. El notebook
`eda_qr_vs_bip_profiles.qmd` se conserva como archivo exploratorio y fuente de
analisis anteriores.

Este notebook busca entender, paso a paso, como difieren las tarjetas que usan
QR respecto de las tarjetas BIP en el panel agregado a nivel `id_tarjeta`.

Caveat central: `id_tarjeta` es una unidad operacional y se usa como proxy de
usuario. Una misma persona podria tener mas de una tarjeta, por lo que las
comparaciones BIP vs QR deben leerse como diferencias entre tarjetas/poblaciones
observadas, no necesariamente entre personas unicas.

Esta version contiene solamente los bloques revisados de composicion,
intensidad, continuidad y repeticion espacial. Los bloques nuevos se agregaran
solo despues de revisar la pregunta y la interpretacion del bloque anterior.

```{python}
def apply_plot_theme() -> None:

        context="notebook",
        style="whitegrid",
        rc={
            "figure.facecolor": FIG_BG,
            "axes.facecolor": AX_BG,
            "savefig.facecolor": FIG_BG,
            "axes.edgecolor": MUTED_TEXT,
            "axes.labelcolor": TEXT_COLOR,

            "ytick.color": TEXT_COLOR,
            "text.color": TEXT_COLOR,

        },
    )
    plt.rcParams.update(
        {
            "figure.dpi": 140,
            "savefig.dpi": 180,
            "axes.spines.top": False,

            "font.size": 10.5,
            "axes.titlesize": 13,
            "axes.titleweight": "bold",
            "axes.labelsize": 10.5,
            "legend.frameon": False,
        }
    )


def style_axis(ax, *, grid_axis: str = "x") -> None:
    ax.set_facecolor(AX_BG)
    ax.grid(False)
    if grid_axis in {"x", "both"}:
        ax.grid(axis="x", color=GRID_COLOR, alpha=0.8, linewidth=0.8)
    if grid_axis in {"y", "both"}:
        ax.grid(axis="y", color=GRID_COLOR, alpha=0.8, linewidth=0.8)
    for side in ["left", "bottom"]:
        ax.spines[side].set_color(MUTED_TEXT)
        ax.spines[side].set_linewidth(0.9)
    ax.tick_params(colors=TEXT_COLOR)
    ax.xaxis.label.set_color(TEXT_COLOR)
    ax.yaxis.label.set_color(TEXT_COLOR)


def add_figure_title(
    fig,
    title: str,
    subtitle: str | None = None,
    *,
    y: float = 0.98,
    subtitle_gap: float = 0.055,
) -> None:

        fig.text(
            0.5,
            y - subtitle_gap,
            subtitle,
            ha="center",

            fontsize=10.5,

def payment_legend_handles(marker_size: int = 70) -> list:
    return [
        plt.Line2D(
            [0],
            [0],
            marker="o",
            linestyle="",
            markerfacecolor=PAYMENT_COLORS[group],
            markeredgecolor="white",
            markeredgewidth=1,
            markersize=np.sqrt(marker_size),
            label=group,
        )
        for group in PAYMENT_ORDER
    ]


apply_plot_theme()


def add_payment_group(lf: pl.LazyFrame) -> pl.LazyFrame:
    return lf.with_columns(
        pl.when(pl.col("is_qr") == 1)
        .then(pl.lit("QR"))
        .otherwise(pl.lit("BIP"))
        .alias("payment_group")
    )


def add_presence_cohort(lf: pl.LazyFrame) -> pl.LazyFrame:
    return lf.with_columns(
        pl.when(pl.col("share_trips_2025") <= 0)
        .then(pl.lit("only_2024"))
        .when(pl.col("share_trips_2025") >= 1)
        .then(pl.lit("only_2025"))
        .otherwise(pl.lit("both_years"))
        .alias("presence_cohort")
    )


def fmt_int(value: float | int) -> str:
    return f"{int(value):,}".replace(",", ".")


def composition_for_lazyframe(lf: pl.LazyFrame, universe: str, label: str) -> pl.DataFrame:
    lf_payment = add_payment_group(lf)
    totals = lf_payment.select(
        [
            pl.len().alias("total_cards"),
            pl.col("n_viajes").sum().alias("total_trips"),
        ]
    ).collect().row(0, named=True)

    return (
        lf_payment.group_by("payment_group")
        .agg(
            [
                pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
                pl.col("n_viajes").sum().alias("n_trips"),
                pl.col("n_viajes").mean().alias("mean_trips_per_card"),
                pl.col("n_viajes").median().alias("median_trips_per_card"),
            ]
        )
        .with_columns(
            [
                pl.lit(universe).alias("universe"),
                pl.lit(label).alias("universe_label"),
                pl.lit(totals["total_cards"]).alias("total_cards"),
                pl.lit(totals["total_trips"]).alias("total_trips"),
                (pl.col("n_cards") / totals["total_cards"]).alias("card_share"),
                (pl.col("n_trips") / totals["total_trips"]).alias("trip_share"),
            ]
        )
        .with_columns((pl.col("trip_share") - pl.col("card_share")).alias("trip_minus_card_share"))
        .sort("payment_group")
        .select(
            [
                "universe",
                "universe_label",
                "payment_group",
                "n_cards",
                "card_share",
                "n_trips",
                "trip_share",
                "trip_minus_card_share",
                "mean_trips_per_card",
                "median_trips_per_card",
                "total_cards",
                "total_trips",
            ]
        )
        .collect()
    )


def cohort_for_lazyframe(lf: pl.LazyFrame, universe: str, label: str) -> pl.DataFrame:
    lf_cohort = add_presence_cohort(add_payment_group(lf))
    return (
        lf_cohort.group_by(["payment_group", "presence_cohort"])
        .agg(
            [
                pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
                pl.col("n_viajes").sum().alias("n_trips"),
                pl.col("share_trips_2025").median().alias("share_trips_2025_median"),
            ]
        )
        .with_columns(
            [
                pl.lit(universe).alias("universe"),
                pl.lit(label).alias("universe_label"),
                (pl.col("n_cards") / pl.col("n_cards").sum().over("payment_group")).alias(
                    "card_share_within_payment"
                ),
                (pl.col("n_trips") / pl.col("n_trips").sum().over("payment_group")).alias(
                    "trip_share_within_payment"
                ),
            ]
        )
        .select(
            [
                "universe",
                "universe_label",
                "payment_group",
                "presence_cohort",
                "n_cards",
                "card_share_within_payment",
                "n_trips",
                "trip_share_within_payment",
                "share_trips_2025_median",
            ]
        )
        .sort(["payment_group", "presence_cohort"])
        .collect()
    )


def first_seen_month_for_lazyframe(
    cards_lf: pl.LazyFrame,
    panel_path: Path,
    universe: str,
    label: str,
) -> pl.DataFrame:
    eligible_cards = (
        add_payment_group(cards_lf)
        .select(
            [
                pl.col("id_tarjeta").cast(pl.Utf8).alias("id_tarjeta"),
                "payment_group",
            ]
        )
        .unique()
    )
    first_seen_lf = (
        pl.scan_parquet(str(panel_path))
        .select(
            [
                pl.col("id_tarjeta").cast(pl.Utf8).alias("id_tarjeta"),
                "first_trip_ts",
            ]
        )
        .join(eligible_cards, on="id_tarjeta", how="inner")
        .filter(pl.col("first_trip_ts").is_not_null())
        .with_columns(
            pl.date(
                pl.col("first_trip_ts").dt.year(),
                pl.col("first_trip_ts").dt.month(),
                pl.lit(1),
            ).alias("first_seen_month")
        )
        .group_by(["payment_group", "first_seen_month"])
        .agg(pl.len().alias("n_cards"))
        .with_columns(
            [
                pl.lit(universe).alias("universe"),
                pl.lit(label).alias("universe_label"),
                pl.col("n_cards").sum().over("payment_group").alias("n_cards_payment"),
            ]
        )
        .with_columns((pl.col("n_cards") / pl.col("n_cards_payment")).alias("share_within_payment"))
        .with_columns(pl.col("first_seen_month").dt.strftime("%Y-%m").alias("first_seen_month_label"))
        .select(
            [
                "universe",
                "universe_label",
                "payment_group",
                "first_seen_month",
                "first_seen_month_label",
                "n_cards",
                "n_cards_payment",
                "share_within_payment",
            ]
        )
        .sort(["payment_group", "first_seen_month"])
    )
    return first_seen_lf.collect()


def observed_exposure_summary_for_lazyframe(
    cards_lf: pl.LazyFrame,
    panel_path: Path,
    observed_weeks: list[str],
    universe: str,
    label: str,
) -> pl.DataFrame:
    week_index = pl.DataFrame(
        {
            "first_seen_week": observed_weeks,
            "first_seen_week_index": list(range(1, len(observed_weeks) + 1)),
        }
    ).lazy()
    eligible_cards = (
        add_payment_group(cards_lf)
        .select(
            [
                pl.col("id_tarjeta").cast(pl.Utf8).alias("id_tarjeta"),
                "payment_group",
                pl.col("n_viajes").cast(pl.Float64).alias("n_viajes"),
            ]
        )
        .unique()
    )
    return (
        pl.scan_parquet(str(panel_path))
        .select(
            [
                pl.col("id_tarjeta").cast(pl.Utf8).alias("id_tarjeta"),
                "first_trip_ts",
            ]
        )
        .join(eligible_cards, on="id_tarjeta", how="inner")
        .filter(pl.col("first_trip_ts").is_not_null())
        .with_columns(pl.col("first_trip_ts").dt.strftime("%G-W%V").alias("first_seen_week"))
        .join(week_index, on="first_seen_week", how="left")
        .filter(pl.col("first_seen_week_index").is_not_null())
        .with_columns(
            (pl.lit(len(observed_weeks)) - pl.col("first_seen_week_index") + 1)
            .cast(pl.Int16)
            .alias("observed_weeks_available")
        )
        .group_by(["payment_group", "observed_weeks_available"])
        .agg(
            [
                pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
                pl.col("n_viajes").quantile(0.25).alias("p25_trips_per_card"),
                pl.col("n_viajes").median().alias("median_trips_per_card"),
                pl.col("n_viajes").quantile(0.75).alias("p75_trips_per_card"),
            ]
        )
        .with_columns(
            [
                pl.lit(universe).alias("universe"),
                pl.lit(label).alias("universe_label"),
            ]
        )
        .select(
            [
                "universe",
                "universe_label",
                "payment_group",
                "observed_weeks_available",
                "n_cards",
                "p25_trips_per_card",
                "median_trips_per_card",
                "p75_trips_per_card",
            ]
        )
        .sort(["payment_group", "observed_weeks_available"])
        .collect()
    )


def adjusted_activity_summary_for_lazyframe(
    cards_lf: pl.LazyFrame,
    panel_path: Path,
    observed_weeks: list[str],
    universe: str,
    label: str,
) -> pl.DataFrame:
    week_index = pl.DataFrame(
        {
            "first_seen_week": observed_weeks,
            "first_seen_week_index": list(range(1, len(observed_weeks) + 1)),
        }
    ).lazy()
    eligible_cards = (
        add_payment_group(cards_lf)
        .select(
            [
                pl.col("id_tarjeta").cast(pl.Utf8).alias("id_tarjeta"),
                "payment_group",
                pl.col("n_viajes").cast(pl.Float64).alias("n_viajes"),
                pl.col("n_semanas_activas").cast(pl.Float64).alias("n_semanas_activas"),
            ]
        )
        .unique()
    )
    base = (
        pl.scan_parquet(str(panel_path))
        .select(
            [
                pl.col("id_tarjeta").cast(pl.Utf8).alias("id_tarjeta"),
                "first_trip_ts",
            ]
        )
        .join(eligible_cards, on="id_tarjeta", how="inner")
        .filter(pl.col("first_trip_ts").is_not_null())
        .with_columns(pl.col("first_trip_ts").dt.strftime("%G-W%V").alias("first_seen_week"))
        .join(week_index, on="first_seen_week", how="left")
        .filter(pl.col("first_seen_week_index").is_not_null())
        .with_columns(
            (pl.lit(len(observed_weeks)) - pl.col("first_seen_week_index") + 1)
            .cast(pl.Float64)
            .alias("observed_weeks_available")
        )
        .filter((pl.col("observed_weeks_available") > 0) & (pl.col("n_semanas_activas") > 0))
        .with_columns(
            [
                (pl.col("n_viajes") / pl.col("observed_weeks_available")).alias(
                    "trips_per_observed_week"
                ),
                (pl.col("n_viajes") / pl.col("n_semanas_activas")).alias(
                    "trips_per_active_week"
                ),
                pl.col("n_semanas_activas").alias("active_weeks"),
            ]
        )
    )

    metric_specs = [
        ("trips_per_observed_week", "Viajes por semana observada", 1),
        ("trips_per_active_week", "Viajes por semana activa", 2),
        ("active_weeks", "Semanas activas", 3),
    ]
    frames = []
    for metric, metric_label, metric_order in metric_specs:
        frames.append(
            base.group_by("payment_group")
            .agg(
                [
                    pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
                    pl.col(metric).quantile(0.25).alias("p25"),
                    pl.col(metric).median().alias("median"),
                    pl.col(metric).quantile(0.75).alias("p75"),
                ]
            )
            .with_columns(
                [
                    pl.lit(universe).alias("universe"),
                    pl.lit(label).alias("universe_label"),
                    pl.lit(metric).alias("metric"),
                    pl.lit(metric_label).alias("metric_label"),
                    pl.lit(metric_order).alias("metric_order"),
                ]
            )
        )

    return (
        pl.concat(frames)
        .select(
            [
                "universe",
                "universe_label",
                "payment_group",
                "metric",
                "metric_label",
                "metric_order",
                "n_cards",
                "p25",
                "median",
                "p75",
            ]
        )
        .sort(["metric_order", "payment_group"])
        .collect()
    )


def _gini_nonnegative(values: np.ndarray) -> float:
    values = np.asarray(values, dtype=float)
    values = values[np.isfinite(values) & (values >= 0)]
    if len(values) == 0 or values.sum() <= 0:
        return np.nan

    sorted_values = np.sort(values)
    n = len(sorted_values)
    ranks = np.arange(1, n + 1)
    return float((2 * np.sum(ranks * sorted_values) / (n * sorted_values.sum())) - ((n + 1) / n))


def card_trip_concentration_for_lazyframe(
    lf: pl.LazyFrame,
    universe: str,
    label: str,
    *,
    top_fracs: tuple[float, ...] = (0.01, 0.05, 0.10, 0.20),
    n_lorenz_points: int = 201,
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    cards = (
        add_payment_group(lf)
        .select(
            [
                "payment_group",
                pl.col("n_viajes").cast(pl.Float64).alias("n_viajes"),
            ]
        )
        .collect()
        .to_pandas()
    )

    summary_rows = []
    curve_frames = []
    grid = np.linspace(0, 1, n_lorenz_points)

    for group in PAYMENT_ORDER:
        values = cards.loc[cards["payment_group"] == group, "n_viajes"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
        values = values[np.isfinite(values) & (values >= 0)]
        n_cards = len(values)
        total_trips = values.sum()

        if n_cards == 0 or total_trips <= 0:
            continue

        sorted_values = np.sort(values)
        cum_cards = np.arange(1, n_cards + 1) / n_cards
        cum_trips = np.cumsum(sorted_values) / total_trips
        sampled_trips = np.interp(grid, np.r_[0, cum_cards], np.r_[0, cum_trips])

        curve_frames.append(
            pd.DataFrame(
                {
                    "universe": universe,
                    "universe_label": label,
                    "payment_group": group,
                    "cum_card_share": grid,
                    "cum_trip_share": sampled_trips,
                }
            )
        )

        descending_values = sorted_values[::-1]
        row = {
            "universe": universe,
            "universe_label": label,
            "payment_group": group,
            "n_cards": n_cards,
            "n_trips": int(total_trips),
            "gini_trips_per_card": _gini_nonnegative(values),
            "median_trips_per_card": float(np.median(values)),
            "p90_trips_per_card": float(np.quantile(values, 0.90)),
            "p99_trips_per_card": float(np.quantile(values, 0.99)),
        }
        for frac in top_fracs:
            top_n = max(1, int(np.ceil(n_cards * frac)))
            row[f"share_trips_top_{int(round(frac * 100))}pct"] = float(
                descending_values[:top_n].sum() / total_trips
            )
        summary_rows.append(row)

    return pd.DataFrame(summary_rows), pd.concat(curve_frames, ignore_index=True)


def card_persistence_summary_for_lazyframe(
    lf: pl.LazyFrame,
    universe: str,
    label: str,
    *,
    top_share: float = 0.20,
) -> pl.DataFrame:
    base = (
        add_payment_group(lf)
        .with_columns(
            (pl.col("n_viajes") * pl.col("share_trips_2025"))
            .round()
            .cast(pl.Int64)
            .alias("n_trips_2025")
        )
        .with_columns(
            (pl.col("n_viajes").cast(pl.Int64) - pl.col("n_trips_2025")).alias(
                "n_trips_2024"
            )
        )
        .with_columns(
            pl.when(pl.col("n_trips_2024") == 0)
            .then(pl.lit("only_2025"))
            .when(pl.col("n_trips_2025") == 0)
            .then(pl.lit("only_2024"))
            .otherwise(pl.lit("both_years"))
            .alias("presence_cohort")
        )
    )

    group_summary = (
        base.group_by("payment_group")
        .agg(
            [
                (pl.col("n_trips_2024") > 0).sum().alias("n_cards_2024"),
                (
                    (pl.col("n_trips_2024") > 0)
                    & (pl.col("n_trips_2025") > 0)
                )
                .sum()
                .alias("n_cards_reobserved_2025"),
                (pl.col("n_trips_2025") > 0).sum().alias("n_cards_2025"),
                pl.col("n_trips_2025").sum().alias("n_trips_2025"),
                pl.when(pl.col("presence_cohort") == "both_years")
                .then(pl.col("n_trips_2025"))
                .otherwise(0)
                .sum()
                .alias("n_trips_2025_recurrent"),
                pl.when(pl.col("presence_cohort") == "only_2025")
                .then(pl.col("n_trips_2025"))
                .otherwise(0)
                .sum()
                .alias("n_trips_2025_only_2025"),
            ]
        )
        .with_columns(
            [
                (
                    pl.col("n_cards_reobserved_2025") / pl.col("n_cards_2024")
                ).alias("share_cards_2024_reobserved_2025"),
                (
                    pl.col("n_trips_2025_recurrent") / pl.col("n_trips_2025")
                ).alias("share_trips_2025_recurrent"),
                (
                    pl.col("n_trips_2025_only_2025") / pl.col("n_trips_2025")
                ).alias("share_trips_2025_only_2025"),
            ]
        )
    )

    recurrent = (
        base.filter(pl.col("presence_cohort") == "both_years")
        .with_columns(
            [
                pl.col("n_trips_2024")
                .rank(method="min", descending=True)
                .over("payment_group")
                .alias("rank_2024"),
                pl.col("n_trips_2025")
                .rank(method="min", descending=True)
                .over("payment_group")
                .alias("rank_2025"),
                pl.len().over("payment_group").alias("n_recurrent_for_ranking"),
            ]
        )
        .with_columns(
            [
                (
                    pl.col("rank_2024")
                    <= (pl.col("n_recurrent_for_ranking") * top_share).ceil()
                ).alias("is_top_2024"),
                (
                    pl.col("rank_2025")
                    <= (pl.col("n_recurrent_for_ranking") * top_share).ceil()
                ).alias("is_top_2025"),
            ]
        )
    )

    top_summary = (
        recurrent.group_by("payment_group")
        .agg(
            [
                pl.len().alias("n_cards_recurrent_for_ranking"),
                pl.col("is_top_2024").sum().alias("n_top_2024"),
                (pl.col("is_top_2024") & pl.col("is_top_2025"))
                .sum()
                .alias("n_top_2024_retained_2025"),
            ]
        )
        .with_columns(
            [
                (
                    pl.col("n_top_2024") / pl.col("n_cards_recurrent_for_ranking")
                ).alias("actual_top_2024_share"),
                (
                    pl.col("n_top_2024_retained_2025") / pl.col("n_top_2024")
                ).alias("share_top_2024_retained_2025"),
            ]
        )
    )

    return (
        group_summary.join(top_summary, on="payment_group", how="left")
        .with_columns(
            [
                pl.lit(universe).alias("universe"),
                pl.lit(label).alias("universe_label"),
                pl.lit(top_share).alias("nominal_top_share"),
            ]
        )
        .select(
            [
                "universe",
                "universe_label",
                "payment_group",
                "n_cards_2024",
                "n_cards_reobserved_2025",
                "share_cards_2024_reobserved_2025",
                "n_cards_2025",
                "n_cards_recurrent_for_ranking",
                "nominal_top_share",
                "actual_top_2024_share",
                "n_top_2024",
                "n_top_2024_retained_2025",
                "share_top_2024_retained_2025",
                "n_trips_2025",
                "n_trips_2025_recurrent",
                "share_trips_2025_recurrent",
                "n_trips_2025_only_2025",
                "share_trips_2025_only_2025",
            ]
        )
        .sort("payment_group")
        .collect()
    )


def card_continuity_by_2024_activity_for_lazyframe(
    lf: pl.LazyFrame,
) -> pl.DataFrame:
    base = (
        add_payment_group(lf)
        .filter(pl.col("n_trips_2024") > 0)
        .with_columns(
            [
                (pl.col("n_trips_2025") > 0).alias("is_reobserved_2025"),
                pl.col("n_active_weeks_2024")
                .cast(pl.Utf8)
                .alias("active_weeks_2024_label"),
                pl.when(pl.col("n_trips_2024") <= 2)
                .then(pl.lit("1-2"))
                .when(pl.col("n_trips_2024") <= 5)
                .then(pl.lit("3-5"))
                .when(pl.col("n_trips_2024") <= 10)
                .then(pl.lit("6-10"))
                .otherwise(pl.lit("11+"))
                .alias("trips_2024_bin"),
                pl.when(pl.col("n_trips_2024") <= 2)
                .then(pl.lit(1))
                .when(pl.col("n_trips_2024") <= 5)
                .then(pl.lit(2))
                .when(pl.col("n_trips_2024") <= 10)
                .then(pl.lit(3))
                .otherwise(pl.lit(4))
                .cast(pl.Int8)
                .alias("trips_2024_bin_order"),
            ]
        )
    )

    week_summary = (
        base.group_by(["payment_group", "n_active_weeks_2024", "active_weeks_2024_label"])
        .agg(
            [
                pl.len().alias("n_cards_2024"),
                pl.col("is_reobserved_2025").sum().alias("n_reobserved_2025"),
            ]
        )
        .with_columns(
            [
                pl.lit("active_weeks_2024").alias("dimension"),
                pl.lit("Semanas activas en 2024").alias("dimension_label"),
                pl.lit(1).cast(pl.Int8).alias("dimension_order"),
                pl.col("active_weeks_2024_label").alias("activity_level"),
                pl.col("n_active_weeks_2024").cast(pl.Int8).alias("level_order"),
            ]
        )
    )

    trip_summary = (
        base.group_by(["payment_group", "trips_2024_bin", "trips_2024_bin_order"])
        .agg(
            [
                pl.len().alias("n_cards_2024"),
                pl.col("is_reobserved_2025").sum().alias("n_reobserved_2025"),
            ]
        )
        .with_columns(
            [
                pl.lit("trips_2024").alias("dimension"),
                pl.lit("Viajes en 2024").alias("dimension_label"),
                pl.lit(2).cast(pl.Int8).alias("dimension_order"),
                pl.col("trips_2024_bin").alias("activity_level"),
                pl.col("trips_2024_bin_order").alias("level_order"),
            ]
        )
    )

    return (
        pl.concat([week_summary, trip_summary], how="diagonal_relaxed")
        .with_columns(
            (
                pl.col("n_reobserved_2025") / pl.col("n_cards_2024")
            ).alias("share_reobserved_2025")
        )
        .select(
            [
                "dimension",
                "dimension_label",
                "dimension_order",
                "activity_level",
                "level_order",
                "payment_group",
                "n_cards_2024",
                "n_reobserved_2025",
                "share_reobserved_2025",
            ]
        )
        .sort(["dimension_order", "level_order", "payment_group"])
        .collect()
    )


def prepare_valid_card_panel(lf: pl.LazyFrame) -> pl.LazyFrame:
    return (
        add_payment_group(
            lf.filter(
                (pl.col("target_conflict_flag") == 0)
                & (pl.col("n_tipo_pago_observed") == 1)
                & (pl.col("n_viajes") > 0)
                & pl.col("is_qr").is_in([0, 1])
                & pl.col("share_trips_2025").is_not_null()
            )
        )
        .with_columns(
            (pl.col("n_viajes") * pl.col("share_trips_2025"))
            .round()
            .cast(pl.Int64)
            .alias("n_trips_2025")
        )
        .with_columns(
            (pl.col("n_viajes").cast(pl.Int64) - pl.col("n_trips_2025")).alias(
                "n_trips_2024"
            )
        )
        .with_columns(
            (
                (pl.col("n_trips_2024") > 0)
                & (pl.col("n_trips_2025") > 0)
            ).alias("is_recurrent")
        )
    )


def active_weeks_by_year_from_trip_paths(
    trip_paths: list[Path],
) -> pl.LazyFrame:
    if not trip_paths:
        raise ValueError("Se requiere al menos un archivo semanal de viajes.")

    weekly_presence = []
    for path in trip_paths:
        week_label = path.stem.replace("viajes_con_te_calculado_", "")
        year = int(week_label.split("-")[0])
        weekly_presence.append(
            pl.scan_parquet(path)
            .select(pl.col("id_tarjeta").cast(pl.Utf8).alias("id_tarjeta"))
            .unique()
            .with_columns(pl.lit(year).cast(pl.Int16).alias("year"))
        )

    return (
        pl.concat(weekly_presence)
        .group_by("id_tarjeta")
        .agg(
            [
                (pl.col("year") == 2024).sum().alias("n_active_weeks_2024"),
                (pl.col("year") == 2025).sum().alias("n_active_weeks_2025"),
            ]
        )
    )


def card_universe_coverage_summary(
    universe_specs: list[tuple[str, str, int, pl.LazyFrame]],
) -> pl.DataFrame:
    broad_lf = min(universe_specs, key=lambda spec: spec[2])[3]
    broad_totals = broad_lf.group_by("payment_group").agg(
        [
            pl.len().alias("n_cards_broad"),
            pl.col("n_viajes").sum().alias("n_trips_broad"),
        ]
    )

    frames = []
    for universe, universe_label, universe_order, universe_lf in universe_specs:
        frames.append(
            universe_lf.group_by("payment_group")
            .agg(
                [
                    pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
                    pl.col("n_viajes").sum().alias("n_trips"),
                ]
            )
            .with_columns(
                [
                    pl.lit(universe).alias("universe"),
                    pl.lit(universe_label).alias("universe_label"),
                    pl.lit(universe_order).alias("universe_order"),
                ]
            )
        )

    return (
        pl.concat(frames)
        .join(broad_totals, on="payment_group", how="left")
        .with_columns(
            [
                (pl.col("n_cards") / pl.col("n_cards_broad")).alias(
                    "share_of_broad_cards"
                ),
                (pl.col("n_trips") / pl.col("n_trips_broad")).alias(
                    "share_of_broad_trips"
                ),
            ]
        )
        .select(
            [
                "universe",
                "universe_label",
                "universe_order",
                "payment_group",
                "n_cards",
                "share_of_broad_cards",
                "n_trips",
                "share_of_broad_trips",
            ]
        )
        .sort(["universe_order", "payment_group"])
        .collect()
    )


def intensity_universe_summary_for_lazyframes(
    universe_specs: list[tuple[str, str, int, pl.LazyFrame]],
) -> pl.DataFrame:
    frames = []
    for universe, universe_label, universe_order, universe_lf in universe_specs:
        frames.append(
            universe_lf.with_columns(
                (
                    pl.col("n_viajes").cast(pl.Float64)
                    / pl.col("n_semanas_activas").cast(pl.Float64)
                ).alias("trips_per_active_week")
            )
            .group_by("payment_group")
            .agg(
                [
                    pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
                    pl.col("n_viajes").median().alias("median_trips"),
                    pl.col("n_dias_activos").median().alias("median_active_days"),
                    pl.col("n_semanas_activas").median().alias("median_active_weeks"),
                    pl.col("trips_per_active_week")
                    .median()
                    .alias("median_trips_per_active_week"),
                ]
            )
            .with_columns(
                [
                    pl.lit(universe).alias("universe"),
                    pl.lit(universe_label).alias("universe_label"),
                    pl.lit(universe_order).alias("universe_order"),
                ]
            )
        )

    return (
        pl.concat(frames)
        .select(
            [
                "universe",
                "universe_label",
                "universe_order",
                "payment_group",
                "n_cards",
                "median_trips",
                "median_active_days",
                "median_active_weeks",
                "median_trips_per_active_week",
            ]
        )
        .sort(["universe_order", "payment_group"])
        .collect()
    )


def intensity_for_lazyframe(lf: pl.LazyFrame, universe: str, label: str) -> pl.DataFrame:
    aggs = [pl.len().alias("n_cards")]
    for var, _ in INTENSITY_VARS:
        aggs.extend(
            [
                pl.col(var).mean().alias(f"{var}__mean"),
                pl.col(var).quantile(0.10).alias(f"{var}__p10"),
                pl.col(var).quantile(0.25).alias(f"{var}__p25"),
                pl.col(var).median().alias(f"{var}__median"),
                pl.col(var).quantile(0.75).alias(f"{var}__p75"),
                pl.col(var).quantile(0.90).alias(f"{var}__p90"),
            ]
        )
    metric_cols = [
        col
        for var, _ in INTENSITY_VARS
        for col in [
            f"{var}__mean",
            f"{var}__p10",
            f"{var}__p25",
            f"{var}__median",
            f"{var}__p75",
            f"{var}__p90",
        ]
    ]

    return (
        add_payment_group(lf)
        .group_by("payment_group")
        .agg(aggs)
        .with_columns(
            [
                pl.lit(universe).alias("universe"),
                pl.lit(label).alias("universe_label"),
            ]
        )
        .select(["universe", "universe_label", "payment_group", "n_cards", *metric_cols])
        .sort("payment_group")
        .collect()
    )


def intensity_summary_long(summary_df: pl.DataFrame | pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    if isinstance(summary_df, pl.DataFrame):
        wide = summary_df.to_pandas()
    else:
        wide = summary_df.copy()

    rows = []
    for _, row in wide.iterrows():
        for var, label in INTENSITY_VARS:
            rows.append(
                {
                    "universe": row["universe"],
                    "universe_label": row["universe_label"],
                    "payment_group": row["payment_group"],
                    "variable": var,
                    "label": label,
                    "n_cards": row["n_cards"],
                    "mean": row[f"{var}__mean"],
                    "p10": row[f"{var}__p10"],
                    "p25": row[f"{var}__p25"],
                    "median": row[f"{var}__median"],
                    "p75": row[f"{var}__p75"],
                    "p90": row[f"{var}__p90"],
                }
            )
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


def regularity_ecdf_for_lazyframe(lf: pl.LazyFrame, universe: str, label: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    lf_regularity = add_payment_group(lf).with_columns(
        (pl.col("n_viajes") / pl.col("n_dias_activos")).alias("viajes_por_dia_activo")
    )

    frames = []
    for metric, metric_label, bin_width in REGULARITY_ECDF_METRICS:
        if bin_width is None:
            value_expr = pl.col(metric).cast(pl.Float64)
        else:
            value_expr = ((pl.col(metric) / bin_width).round(0) * bin_width).cast(pl.Float64)

        metric_counts = (
            lf_regularity.select(["payment_group", metric])
            .with_columns(value_expr.alias("value"))
            .filter(pl.col("value").is_not_null())
            .group_by(["payment_group", "value"])
            .agg(pl.len().alias("n"))
            .collect()
            .to_pandas()
        )
        metric_counts["universe"] = universe
        metric_counts["universe_label"] = label
        metric_counts["metric"] = metric
        metric_counts["metric_label"] = metric_label
        metric_counts = metric_counts.sort_values(["payment_group", "value"])
        metric_counts["cum_n"] = metric_counts.groupby("payment_group")["n"].cumsum()
        metric_counts["total_n"] = metric_counts.groupby("payment_group")["n"].transform("sum")
        metric_counts["cum_share"] = metric_counts["cum_n"] / metric_counts["total_n"]
        frames.append(metric_counts)

    return pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)


def plot_composition_donuts(
    composition_df: pl.DataFrame | pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    title: str,
    subtitle: str | None = None,
    figsize: tuple[float, float] = (10.5, 5.2),
) -> None:
    if isinstance(composition_df, pl.DataFrame):
        plot_df = composition_df.to_pandas()
    else:
        plot_df = composition_df.copy()

    plot_df = plot_df.set_index("payment_group").loc[PAYMENT_ORDER]
    panels = [
        ("card_share", "n_cards", "Tarjetas"),
        ("trip_share", "n_trips", "Viajes"),
    ]

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=figsize)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)
    wedgeprops = {"width": 0.40, "edgecolor": FIG_BG, "linewidth": 4}

    for ax, (share_col, count_col, panel_title) in zip(axes, panels):
        ax.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)
        shares = plot_df[share_col].to_numpy()
        counts = plot_df[count_col].to_numpy()
        colors = [PAYMENT_COLORS[group] for group in PAYMENT_ORDER]

        wedges, _ = ax.pie(
            shares,
            startangle=90,
            counterclock=False,
            colors=colors,
            wedgeprops=wedgeprops,
        )

        for wedge, group, share, count in zip(wedges, PAYMENT_ORDER, shares, counts):
            angle = np.deg2rad((wedge.theta1 + wedge.theta2) / 2)
            x, y = 0.76 * np.cos(angle), 0.76 * np.sin(angle)
            ax.text(
                x,
                y,
                f"{group}\n{share:.1%}",
                ha="center",
                va="center",
                color="white",
                fontsize=10.5,
                fontweight="bold",
            )
            x2, y2 = 1.22 * np.cos(angle), 1.22 * np.sin(angle)
            ax.text(
                x2,
                y2,
                f"n={fmt_int(count)}",
                ha="center",
                va="center",
                color=PAYMENT_COLORS[group],
                fontsize=9,
                fontweight="bold",
            )

        ax.text(
            0,
            0,
            panel_title,
            ha="center",
            va="center",
            fontsize=13,
            fontweight="bold",
            color=TEXT_COLOR,
        )
        ax.set_title(f"Share de {panel_title.lower()}", pad=12, color=TEXT_COLOR)
        ax.set_aspect("equal")

    add_figure_title(fig, title, subtitle, y=0.98, subtitle_gap=0.08)
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.05, right=0.95, top=0.78, bottom=0.07, wspace=0.28)
    plt.show()


def plot_first_seen_month_distribution(
    first_seen_df: pl.DataFrame | pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    title: str,
    figsize: tuple[float, float] = (7.2, 4.4),
) -> None:
    if isinstance(first_seen_df, pl.DataFrame):
        plot_df = first_seen_df.to_pandas()
    else:
        plot_df = first_seen_df.copy()

    plot_df["first_seen_month"] = pd.to_datetime(plot_df["first_seen_month"])
    month_order = sorted(plot_df["first_seen_month"].dropna().unique())
    month_labels = [pd.Timestamp(month).strftime("%Y-%m") for month in month_order]
    x = np.arange(len(month_order))
    width = 0.34

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)
    ax.set_facecolor(AX_BG)

    for idx, group in enumerate(PAYMENT_ORDER):
        group_df = (
            plot_df.loc[plot_df["payment_group"] == group]
            .set_index("first_seen_month")
            .reindex(month_order)
        )
        values = group_df["share_within_payment"].fillna(0).to_numpy()
        counts = group_df["n_cards"].fillna(0).to_numpy()
        offset = (idx - 0.5) * width
        bars = ax.bar(
            x + offset,
            values,
            width=width,
            color=PAYMENT_COLORS[group],
            alpha=0.92,
            label=group,
        )
        for bar, value, count in zip(bars, values, counts):
            if count <= 0:
                continue
            ax.text(
                bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2,
                bar.get_height() + 0.012,
                f"{value:.1%}",
                ha="center",
                va="bottom",
                fontsize=9,
                fontweight="bold",
                color=TEXT_COLOR,
            )

    style_axis(ax, grid_axis="y")
    ax.set_xticks(x)
    ax.set_xticklabels(month_labels)
    ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(PercentFormatter(1.0))
    ax.set_ylim(0, min(1.0, max(0.12, plot_df["share_within_payment"].max() * 1.18)))
    ax.set_xlabel("Mes de primera aparicion observada")
    ax.set_ylabel("% dentro de cada grupo de pago")
    ax.legend(loc="upper center", bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.18), ncol=2)
    add_figure_title(fig, title, y=0.98)
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.11, right=0.98, top=0.82, bottom=0.25)
    plt.show()

def plot_adjusted_activity_summary(
    summary_df: pl.DataFrame | pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    title: str,
    figsize: tuple[float, float] = (11.0, 4.4),
) -> None:
    if isinstance(summary_df, pl.DataFrame):
        plot_df = summary_df.to_pandas()
    else:
        plot_df = summary_df.copy()

    metrics = (
        plot_df[["metric", "metric_label", "metric_order"]]
        .drop_duplicates()
        .sort_values("metric_order")
    )
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, len(metrics), figsize=figsize)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)
    if len(metrics) == 1:
        axes = [axes]

    y_positions = {"BIP": 1, "QR": 0}
    y_labels = ["QR", "BIP"]

    for ax, (_, metric_row) in zip(axes, metrics.iterrows()):
        metric_df = plot_df.loc[plot_df["metric"] == metric_row["metric"]].copy()
        ax.set_facecolor(AX_BG)
        style_axis(ax, grid_axis="x")
        for group in PAYMENT_ORDER:
            row = metric_df.loc[metric_df["payment_group"] == group]
            if row.empty:
                continue
            row = row.iloc[0]
            y = y_positions[group]
            ax.hlines(
                y,
                row["p25"],
                row["p75"],
                color=PAYMENT_COLORS[group],
                linewidth=4,
                alpha=0.35,
            )
            ax.scatter(
                row["median"],
                y,
                s=70,
                color=PAYMENT_COLORS[group],
                edgecolor="white",
                linewidth=1.0,
                zorder=3,
                label=group,
            )
            ax.text(
                row["median"],
                y + 0.12,
                f"{row['median']:.1f}",
                ha="center",
                va="bottom",
                fontsize=9,
                color=TEXT_COLOR,
            )

        ax.set_title(metric_row["metric_label"], color=TEXT_COLOR, pad=10)
        ax.set_yticks([0, 1])
        ax.set_yticklabels(y_labels)
        ax.set_ylim(-0.45, 1.45)
        ax.set_xlabel("Valor por tarjeta")

    add_figure_title(fig, title, y=0.98)
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.07, right=0.98, top=0.78, bottom=0.18, wspace=0.35)
    plt.show()

def plot_card_persistence_summary(
    summary_df: pl.DataFrame | pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    title: str,
    figsize: tuple[float, float] = (13.2, 4.4),
) -> None:
    if isinstance(summary_df, pl.DataFrame):
        plot_df = summary_df.to_pandas()
    else:
        plot_df = summary_df.copy()
    plot_df = plot_df.set_index("payment_group").reindex(PAYMENT_ORDER)

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=figsize)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)
    y = np.arange(len(PAYMENT_ORDER))
    payment_colors = [PAYMENT_COLORS[group] for group in PAYMENT_ORDER]

    metric_specs = [
        ("share_cards_2024_reobserved_2025", "Reobservadas en 2025"),
        ("share_top_2024_retained_2025", "Top 20% que permanece top"),
    ]
    for ax, (metric, panel_title) in zip(axes[:2], metric_specs):
        values = plot_df[metric].to_numpy(dtype=float)
        ax.barh(y, values, color=payment_colors, height=0.56, alpha=0.92)
        for idx, value in enumerate(values):
            ax.text(
                min(value + 0.025, 0.98),
                idx,
                f"{value:.1%}",
                va="center",
                ha="left",
                fontsize=9,
                color=TEXT_COLOR,
                fontweight="bold",
            )
        ax.set_title(panel_title, color=TEXT_COLOR, pad=10)
        ax.set_yticks(y)
        ax.set_yticklabels(PAYMENT_ORDER)
        ax.invert_yaxis()
        ax.set_xlim(0, 1)
        ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(PercentFormatter(1.0))
        style_axis(ax, grid_axis="x")

    ax = axes[2]
    recurrent = plot_df["share_trips_2025_recurrent"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    only_2025 = plot_df["share_trips_2025_only_2025"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    ax.barh(
        y,
        recurrent,
        height=0.56,
        color=COHORT_COLORS["both_years"],
        label="Reobservadas",
    )
    ax.barh(
        y,
        only_2025,
        left=recurrent,
        height=0.56,
        color=COHORT_COLORS["only_2025"],
        label="Solo 2025",
    )
    for idx, (recurrent_value, only_value) in enumerate(zip(recurrent, only_2025)):
        ax.text(
            recurrent_value / 2,
            idx,
            f"{recurrent_value:.1%}",
            ha="center",
            va="center",
            fontsize=8.8,
            color="white",
            fontweight="bold",
        )
        ax.text(
            recurrent_value + only_value / 2,
            idx,
            f"{only_value:.1%}",
            ha="center",
            va="center",
            fontsize=8.8,
            color="white",
            fontweight="bold",
        )
    ax.set_title("Viajes observados en 2025", color=TEXT_COLOR, pad=10)
    ax.set_yticks(y)
    ax.set_yticklabels(PAYMENT_ORDER)
    ax.invert_yaxis()
    ax.set_xlim(0, 1)
    ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(PercentFormatter(1.0))
    style_axis(ax, grid_axis="x")
    ax.legend(loc="upper center", bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.17), ncol=2, frameon=False)

    add_figure_title(fig, title, y=0.98)
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.06, right=0.98, top=0.78, bottom=0.24, wspace=0.38)
    plt.show()


def plot_card_continuity_by_2024_activity(
    continuity_df: pl.DataFrame | pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    title: str = "Continuidad observada segun actividad en 2024",
    figsize: tuple[float, float] = (11.0, 4.4),
) -> None:
    plot_df = (
        continuity_df.to_pandas()
        if isinstance(continuity_df, pl.DataFrame)
        else continuity_df.copy()
    )
    dimensions = (
        plot_df[["dimension", "dimension_label", "dimension_order"]]
        .drop_duplicates()
        .sort_values("dimension_order")
    )

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, len(dimensions), figsize=figsize, sharey=True)
    axes = np.atleast_1d(axes)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)

    for ax, dimension_row in zip(axes, dimensions.itertuples(index=False)):
        panel = plot_df.loc[plot_df["dimension"].eq(dimension_row.dimension)].copy()
        level_order = (
            panel[["activity_level", "level_order"]]
            .drop_duplicates()
            .sort_values("level_order")
        )
        x_labels = level_order["activity_level"].tolist()
        x = np.arange(len(x_labels))

        for payment_group in PAYMENT_ORDER:
            values = (
                panel.loc[panel["payment_group"].eq(payment_group)]
                .set_index("activity_level")
                .reindex(x_labels)["share_reobserved_2025"]
                .to_numpy(dtype=float)
            )
            ax.plot(
                x,
                values,
                marker="o",
                markersize=5.5,
                linewidth=2.1,
                color=PAYMENT_COLORS[payment_group],
                label=payment_group,
            )

        ax.set_title(dimension_row.dimension_label, color=TEXT_COLOR, pad=10)
        ax.set_xticks(x)
        ax.set_xticklabels(x_labels)
        ax.set_ylim(0, 1)
        ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(PercentFormatter(1.0))
        style_axis(ax, grid_axis="y")

    axes[0].set_ylabel("Tarjetas reobservadas en 2025")
    axes[-1].legend(loc="lower right", frameon=False)
    add_figure_title(fig, title, y=0.98)
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.09, right=0.98, top=0.80, bottom=0.16, wspace=0.22)
    plt.show()


def plot_intensity_dumbbells(
    summary_df: pl.DataFrame | pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    title: str,
    subtitle: str | None = None,
    metric: str = "median",
    figsize: tuple[float, float] = (9.5, 5.6),
) -> None:
    plot_df = intensity_summary_long(summary_df)
    label_order = [label for _, label in INTENSITY_VARS]
    pivot = (
        plot_df.pivot_table(
            index="label",
            columns="payment_group",
            values=metric,
            aggfunc="first",
        )
        .reindex(index=label_order, columns=PAYMENT_ORDER)
    )

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)
    y_positions = np.arange(len(label_order))[::-1] * 1.25
    max_value = float(np.nanmax(pivot.to_numpy()))
    label_pad = max(max_value * 0.05, 0.7)

    for idx, label in enumerate(label_order):
        y = y_positions[idx]
        bip_value = pivot.loc[label, "BIP"]
        qr_value = pivot.loc[label, "QR"]
        same_value = np.isclose(bip_value, qr_value)

        ax.plot(
            [bip_value, qr_value],
            [y, y],
            color=NEUTRAL_LINE,
            linewidth=4.0,
            alpha=0.72,
            zorder=1,
        )
        ax.scatter(
            [bip_value, qr_value],
            [y + (0.06 if same_value else 0), y - (0.06 if same_value else 0)],
            s=98,
            color=[PAYMENT_COLORS["BIP"], PAYMENT_COLORS["QR"]],
            edgecolor="white",
            linewidth=1.4,
            zorder=3,
        )

        for value, group, y_shift in [
            (bip_value, "BIP", 0.20 if same_value else 0.18),
            (qr_value, "QR", -0.22 if same_value else 0.18),
        ]:
            ax.text(
                value,
                y + y_shift,
                f"{value:.0f}",
                ha="center",
                va="bottom" if y_shift > 0 else "top",
                fontsize=9.5,
                color=PAYMENT_COLORS[group],
                fontweight="bold",
            )

    ax.set_yticks(y_positions)
    ax.set_yticklabels(label_order)
    ax.set_ylim(-0.50, y_positions.max() + 0.70)
    ax.set_xlim(left=0, right=max_value + label_pad)
    ax.set_xlabel("Valor mediano por tarjeta")
    style_axis(ax, grid_axis="x")
    ax.legend(
        handles=payment_legend_handles(98),
        loc="lower center",
        bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.28),
        ncol=2,
    )

    add_figure_title(fig, title, subtitle, y=0.965)
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.16, right=0.96, top=0.78, bottom=0.22)
    plt.show()


def plot_intensity_by_universe(
    summary_df: pl.DataFrame | pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    title: str,
    figsize: tuple[float, float] = (10.8, 7.0),
) -> None:
    if isinstance(summary_df, pl.DataFrame):
        plot_df = summary_df.to_pandas()
    else:
        plot_df = summary_df.copy()

    metric_specs = [
        ("median_trips", "Viajes"),
        ("median_active_days", "Dias activos"),
        ("median_active_weeks", "Semanas activas"),
        ("median_trips_per_active_week", "Viajes por semana activa"),
    ]
    universe_order = (
        plot_df[["universe_label", "universe_order"]]
        .drop_duplicates()
        .sort_values("universe_order")["universe_label"]
        .tolist()
    )
    y_positions = np.arange(len(universe_order))[::-1]

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=figsize)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)

    for ax, (metric, panel_title) in zip(axes.flat, metric_specs):
        panel_max = float(plot_df[metric].max())
        x_margin = max(panel_max * 0.08, 0.45)

        for y, universe_label in zip(y_positions, universe_order):
            rows = plot_df.loc[plot_df["universe_label"] == universe_label].set_index(
                "payment_group"
            )
            bip_value = float(rows.loc["BIP", metric])
            qr_value = float(rows.loc["QR", metric])
            same_value = np.isclose(bip_value, qr_value)

            ax.hlines(
                y,
                min(bip_value, qr_value),
                max(bip_value, qr_value),
                color=NEUTRAL_LINE,
                linewidth=4.0,
                alpha=0.72,
                zorder=1,
            )
            ax.scatter(
                [bip_value, qr_value],
                [y + (0.05 if same_value else 0), y - (0.05 if same_value else 0)],
                s=82,
                color=[PAYMENT_COLORS["BIP"], PAYMENT_COLORS["QR"]],
                edgecolor="white",
                linewidth=1.2,
                zorder=3,
            )
            for value, group, y_shift in [
                (bip_value, "BIP", 0.17),
                (qr_value, "QR", -0.20 if same_value else 0.17),
            ]:
                ax.text(
                    value,
                    y + y_shift,
                    f"{value:.1f}",
                    ha="center",
                    va="bottom" if y_shift > 0 else "top",
                    fontsize=8.8,
                    color=PAYMENT_COLORS[group],
                    fontweight="bold",
                )

        ax.set_title(panel_title, color=TEXT_COLOR, pad=10)
        ax.set_yticks(y_positions)
        ax.set_yticklabels(universe_order)
        ax.set_xlim(0, panel_max + x_margin)
        ax.set_ylim(-0.45, y_positions.max() + 0.45)
        ax.set_xlabel("Mediana por tarjeta")
        style_axis(ax, grid_axis="x")

    handles = payment_legend_handles(80)
    fig.legend(
        handles=handles,
        loc="lower center",
        bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 0.01),
        ncol=2,
        frameon=False,
    )
    add_figure_title(fig, title, y=0.98)
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.08, right=0.98, top=0.84, bottom=0.12, wspace=0.24, hspace=0.42)
    plt.show()


def plot_intensity_percentile_profiles(
    summary_df: pl.DataFrame | pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    title: str,
    subtitle: str | None = None,
    figsize: tuple[float, float] = (11.5, 4.6),
) -> None:
    plot_df = intensity_summary_long(summary_df)
    percentiles = [
        ("p25", "p25"),
        ("median", "p50"),
        ("p75", "p75"),
        ("p90", "p90"),
    ]
    label_order = [label for _, label in INTENSITY_VARS]

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, len(label_order), figsize=figsize, sharey=False)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)
    if len(label_order) == 1:
        axes = [axes]

    for ax, label in zip(axes, label_order):
        panel = plot_df[plot_df["label"] == label]
        x = np.arange(len(percentiles))

        for group in PAYMENT_ORDER:
            values = [
                panel.loc[panel["payment_group"] == group, col].iloc[0]
                for col, _ in percentiles
            ]
            ax.plot(
                x,
                values,
                marker="o",
                linewidth=2.8,
                markersize=7.5,
                color=PAYMENT_COLORS[group],
                label=group,
            )

            label_x_shift = -4 if group == "BIP" else 4
            label_ha = "right" if group == "BIP" else "left"
            for xx, value in zip(x, values):
                ax.annotate(
                    f"{value:.0f}",
                    xy=(xx, value),
                    xytext=(label_x_shift, 8),
                    textcoords="offset points",
                    ha=label_ha,
                    va="bottom",
                    fontsize=8.5,
                    color=PAYMENT_COLORS[group],
                    fontweight="bold",
                )

        ax.set_title(label, fontsize=12, fontweight="bold", color=TEXT_COLOR, pad=12)
        ax.set_xticks(x)
        ax.set_xticklabels([name for _, name in percentiles])
        ax.set_xlabel("Percentil")
        style_axis(ax, grid_axis="y")

    axes[0].set_ylabel("Valor por tarjeta")
    fig.legend(handles=payment_legend_handles(80), loc="lower center", ncol=2, frameon=False)

    add_figure_title(fig, title, subtitle, y=0.98, subtitle_gap=0.08)
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.07, right=0.98, top=0.78, bottom=0.24, wspace=0.25)
    plt.show()


def plot_regularidad_ecdf(
    ecdf_df: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    title: str,
    subtitle: str | None = None,
    figsize: tuple[float, float] = (11.5, 5.2),
) -> None:
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=figsize, sharey=True)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)

    for ax, (metric, metric_label, _) in zip(axes, REGULARITY_ECDF_METRICS):
        panel = ecdf_df[ecdf_df["metric"] == metric].copy()
        x_max_candidates = panel.loc[panel["cum_share"] <= 0.995, "value"]
        x_max = x_max_candidates.max() if len(x_max_candidates) else panel["value"].max()
        x_max = max(float(x_max) * 1.05, 1.0)

        for group in PAYMENT_ORDER:
            group_df = panel[panel["payment_group"] == group].sort_values("value")
            ax.step(
                group_df["value"],
                group_df["cum_share"],
                where="post",
                linewidth=2.7,
                color=PAYMENT_COLORS[group],
                label=group,
            )

            median_row = group_df[group_df["cum_share"] >= 0.5].head(1)
            if not median_row.empty:
                median_x = float(median_row["value"].iloc[0])
                ax.scatter(
                    [median_x],
                    [0.5],
                    s=62,
                    color=PAYMENT_COLORS[group],
                    edgecolor=AX_BG,
                    linewidth=1.2,
                    zorder=4,
                )
                ax.annotate(
                    f"mediana {median_x:.1f}",
                    xy=(median_x, 0.5),
                    xytext=(8, 8 if group == "BIP" else -14),
                    textcoords="offset points",
                    ha="left",
                    va="center",
                    fontsize=8.5,
                    fontweight="bold",
                    color=PAYMENT_COLORS[group],
                )

        ax.axhline(0.5, color=NEUTRAL_LINE, linewidth=1.0, linestyle="--", alpha=0.8)
        ax.axhline(0.75, color=NEUTRAL_LINE, linewidth=0.9, linestyle=":", alpha=0.75)
        ax.text(
            x_max,
            0.505,
            "50%",
            ha="right",
            va="bottom",
            fontsize=8.5,
            color=MUTED_TEXT,
        )
        ax.text(
            x_max,
            0.755,
            "75%",
            ha="right",
            va="bottom",
            fontsize=8.5,
            color=MUTED_TEXT,
        )

        ax.set_title(metric_label, fontsize=12.5, fontweight="bold", color=TEXT_COLOR, pad=12)
        ax.set_xlabel(metric_label)
        ax.set_xlim(0, x_max)
        ax.set_ylim(0, 1.01)
        ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(PercentFormatter(1))
        style_axis(ax, grid_axis="both")

    axes[0].set_ylabel("Share acumulado de tarjetas")
    axes[1].legend(handles=payment_legend_handles(70), loc="lower right", frameon=False)
    add_figure_title(fig, title, subtitle, y=0.98)

    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.08, right=0.98, top=0.76, bottom=0.18, wspace=0.16)
    plt.show()


def plot_regularidad_ecdf_universe_comparison(
    ecdf_df: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    universe_labels: tuple[str, str] = ("Amplio", "Repetido"),
    title: str = "Regularidad: universo amplio versus repetido",
    figsize: tuple[float, float] = (11.8, 7.8),
) -> None:
    plot_df = ecdf_df.loc[
        ecdf_df["universe_label"].isin(universe_labels)
    ].copy()
    if plot_df.empty:
        raise ValueError("No hay datos para los universos solicitados.")

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(
        len(REGULARITY_ECDF_METRICS),
        len(universe_labels),
        figsize=figsize,
        sharey=True,
        squeeze=False,
    )
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)

    for row_idx, (metric, metric_label, _) in enumerate(REGULARITY_ECDF_METRICS):
        metric_df = plot_df.loc[plot_df["metric"].eq(metric)].copy()
        x_max_candidates = metric_df.loc[metric_df["cum_share"] <= 0.995, "value"]
        x_max = (
            x_max_candidates.max()
            if len(x_max_candidates)
            else metric_df["value"].max()
        )
        x_max = max(float(x_max) * 1.05, 1.0)

        for col_idx, universe_label in enumerate(universe_labels):
            ax = axes[row_idx, col_idx]
            panel = metric_df.loc[
                metric_df["universe_label"].eq(universe_label)
            ]

            for group in PAYMENT_ORDER:
                group_df = panel.loc[
                    panel["payment_group"].eq(group)
                ].sort_values("value")
                ax.step(
                    group_df["value"],
                    group_df["cum_share"],
                    where="post",
                    linewidth=2.5,
                    color=PAYMENT_COLORS[group],
                )

                median_row = group_df.loc[group_df["cum_share"] >= 0.5].head(1)
                if not median_row.empty:
                    median_x = float(median_row["value"].iloc[0])
                    ax.scatter(
                        [median_x],
                        [0.5],
                        s=55,
                        color=PAYMENT_COLORS[group],
                        edgecolor=AX_BG,
                        linewidth=1.1,
                        zorder=4,
                    )
                    ax.annotate(
                        f"{median_x:.1f}",
                        xy=(median_x, 0.5),
                        xytext=(7, 8 if group == "BIP" else -13),
                        textcoords="offset points",
                        ha="left",
                        va="center",
                        fontsize=8.3,
                        fontweight="bold",
                        color=PAYMENT_COLORS[group],
                    )

            ax.axhline(
                0.5,
                color=NEUTRAL_LINE,
                linewidth=1.0,
                linestyle="--",
                alpha=0.8,
            )
            ax.axhline(
                0.75,
                color=NEUTRAL_LINE,
                linewidth=0.9,
                linestyle=":",
                alpha=0.75,
            )
            if row_idx == 0:
                ax.set_title(
                    universe_label,
                    fontsize=12.5,
                    fontweight="bold",
                    color=TEXT_COLOR,
                    pad=10,
                )
            ax.set_xlabel(metric_label)
            ax.set_xlim(0, x_max)
            ax.set_ylim(0, 1.01)
            ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(PercentFormatter(1))
            style_axis(ax, grid_axis="both")

        axes[row_idx, 0].set_ylabel(
            f"{metric_label}\nShare acumulado de tarjetas"
        )

    fig.legend(
        handles=payment_legend_handles(70),
        loc="lower center",
        ncol=2,
        frameon=False,
    )
    add_figure_title(fig, title, y=0.985)
    fig.subplots_adjust(
        left=0.10,
        right=0.98,
        top=0.88,
        bottom=0.12,
        wspace=0.14,
        hspace=0.34,
    )
    plt.show()


def plot_within_week_regularity_by_universe(
    summary_df: pl.DataFrame | pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    title: str = "Regularidad dentro de las semanas activas",
    figsize: tuple[float, float] = (11.2, 4.8),
) -> None:
    plot_df = summary_df.to_pandas() if isinstance(summary_df, pl.DataFrame) else summary_df.copy()
    metric_specs = [
        ("median_active_days_per_week", "Dias activos por semana activa"),
        ("median_trips_per_active_day", "Viajes por dia activo"),
    ]
    universe_order = (
        plot_df[["universe_label", "universe_order"]]
        .drop_duplicates()
        .sort_values("universe_order")["universe_label"]
        .tolist()
    )
    y_positions = np.arange(len(universe_order))[::-1]

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=figsize)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)

    for ax, (metric, panel_title) in zip(axes, metric_specs):
        panel_max = float(plot_df[metric].max())
        x_margin = max(panel_max * 0.14, 0.30)

        for y, universe_label in zip(y_positions, universe_order):
            rows = plot_df.loc[
                plot_df["universe_label"].eq(universe_label)
            ].set_index("payment_group")
            bip_value = float(rows.loc["BIP", metric])
            qr_value = float(rows.loc["QR", metric])

            ax.hlines(
                y,
                min(bip_value, qr_value),
                max(bip_value, qr_value),
                color=NEUTRAL_LINE,
                linewidth=4.0,
                alpha=0.72,
                zorder=1,
            )
            ax.scatter(
                [bip_value, qr_value],
                [y + 0.035, y - 0.035],
                s=78,
                color=[PAYMENT_COLORS["BIP"], PAYMENT_COLORS["QR"]],
                edgecolor="white",
                linewidth=1.1,
                zorder=3,
            )
            for value, group, y_shift in [
                (bip_value, "BIP", 0.16),
                (qr_value, "QR", -0.18),
            ]:
                ax.text(
                    value,
                    y + y_shift,
                    f"{value:.2f}",
                    ha="center",
                    va="bottom" if y_shift > 0 else "top",
                    fontsize=8.7,
                    color=PAYMENT_COLORS[group],
                    fontweight="bold",
                )

        ax.set_title(panel_title, color=TEXT_COLOR, pad=10)
        ax.set_yticks(y_positions)
        ax.set_yticklabels(universe_order)
        ax.set_xlim(0, panel_max + x_margin)
        ax.set_ylim(-0.45, y_positions.max() + 0.45)
        ax.set_xlabel("Mediana por tarjeta")
        style_axis(ax, grid_axis="x")

    fig.legend(
        handles=payment_legend_handles(75),
        loc="lower center",
        bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 0.01),
        ncol=2,
        frameon=False,
    )
    add_figure_title(fig, title, y=0.98)
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.11, right=0.98, top=0.78, bottom=0.20, wspace=0.26)
    plt.show()


def plot_active_days_per_week_conditioned(

    title: str = "Dias activos por semana, a igual numero de semanas activas",

    fig.patch.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)

        axes = np.array([axes])

    fig.legend(

        loc="lower center",
        bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 0.01),
        ncol=2,

    )

    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.09, right=0.98, top=0.78, bottom=0.22, wspace=0.16)
    plt.show()


def plot_od_repetition_by_trip_bin(
    profile_df: pl.DataFrame | pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    title: str = "Repeticion del OD y la ruta segun numero de viajes",
) -> None:
    plot_df = (
        profile_df.to_pandas()
        if isinstance(profile_df, pl.DataFrame)
        else profile_df.copy()
    )
    universe_order = (
        plot_df[["universe_label", "universe_order"]]
        .drop_duplicates()
        .sort_values("universe_order")["universe_label"]
        .tolist()
    )
    trip_bins = (
        plot_df[["trip_bin", "trip_bin_order"]]
        .drop_duplicates()
        .sort_values("trip_bin_order")["trip_bin"]
        .tolist()
    )
    metrics = [
        ("median_od_top1_share", "OD principal (direccion exacta)"),
        ("median_main_route_share", "Ruta principal (ida y vuelta)"),
    ]

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(
        len(universe_order),
        len(metrics),
        figsize=(12.8, 4.0 * len(universe_order)),
        squeeze=False,
        sharex=True,
    )
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)
    x = np.arange(len(trip_bins))

    for row_idx, universe_label in enumerate(universe_order):
        universe_df = plot_df.loc[
            plot_df["universe_label"].eq(universe_label)
        ]
        for col_idx, (metric, metric_label) in enumerate(metrics):
            ax = axes[row_idx, col_idx]
            for payment_group in PAYMENT_ORDER:
                line_df = (
                    universe_df.loc[
                        universe_df["payment_group"].eq(payment_group)
                    ]
                    .set_index("trip_bin")
                    .reindex(trip_bins)
                )
                ax.plot(
                    x,
                    line_df[metric],
                    color=PAYMENT_COLORS[payment_group],
                    marker="o",
                    linewidth=2.2,
                    markersize=6.5,
                    label=payment_group,
                )

            ax.set_title(
                f"{universe_label} | {metric_label}",
                fontsize=12.5,
                fontweight="bold",
                color=TEXT_COLOR,
            )
            ax.set_xticks(x)
            ax.set_xticklabels(trip_bins)
            ax.set_xlabel("Viajes observados por tarjeta")
            ax.set_ylabel("Mediana")
            ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(PercentFormatter(1.0))
            style_axis(ax, grid_axis="y")

    axes[0, -1].legend(
        handles=payment_legend_handles(70),
        loc="upper right",
        frameon=False,
    )
    add_figure_title(fig, title, y=0.99)
    fig.subplots_adjust(
        left=0.08,
        right=0.98,
        top=0.91,
        bottom=0.09,
        hspace=0.38,
        wspace=0.22,
    )
    plt.show()

def plot_cohort_stacked_bars(
    cohort_df: pl.DataFrame | pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    title: str,
    subtitle: str | None = None,
    figsize: tuple[float, float] = (9.8, 4.8),
) -> None:
    if isinstance(cohort_df, pl.DataFrame):
        plot_df = cohort_df.to_pandas()
    else:
        plot_df = cohort_df.copy()

    pivot = (
        plot_df.pivot_table(
            index="payment_group",
            columns="presence_cohort",
            values="card_share_within_payment",
            aggfunc="sum",
            fill_value=0,
        )
        .reindex(index=PAYMENT_ORDER, columns=COHORT_ORDER, fill_value=0)
    )

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)
    ax.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)
    y = np.arange(len(PAYMENT_ORDER))
    left = np.zeros(len(PAYMENT_ORDER))

    for cohort in COHORT_ORDER:
        values = pivot[cohort].to_numpy()
        ax.barh(
            y,
            values,
            left=left,
            height=0.58,
            color=COHORT_COLORS[cohort],
            label=COHORT_LABELS[cohort],
            edgecolor=FIG_BG,
            linewidth=1.2,
        )
        for idx, value in enumerate(values):
            if value >= 0.07:
                ax.text(
                    left[idx] + value / 2,
                    y[idx],
                    f"{value:.1%}",
                    ha="center",
                    va="center",
                    fontsize=9,
                    color="white",
                    fontweight="bold",
                )
        left += values

    qr_only_2025 = pivot.loc["QR", "only_2025"]
    bip_only_2025 = pivot.loc["BIP", "only_2025"]
    diff = qr_only_2025 - bip_only_2025

    ax.set_yticks(y)
    ax.set_yticklabels(PAYMENT_ORDER)
    ax.set_xlim(0, 1)
    ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(PercentFormatter(1.0))
    ax.set_xlabel("Share de tarjetas dentro de cada grupo de pago")
    style_axis(ax, grid_axis="x")

    if subtitle is None:
        subtitle = (
            f"Share solo 2025: QR {qr_only_2025:.1%} vs BIP {bip_only_2025:.1%} "
            f"(diferencia {diff:+.1%})."
        )
    add_figure_title(fig, title, subtitle, y=0.98, subtitle_gap=0.08)
    ax.legend(
        loc="upper center",
        bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 1.38),
        ncol=3,
        title="Cohorte observada",
        title_fontsize=9.5,
        fontsize=9.5,
        handlelength=1.8,
        columnspacing=1.2,
    )

    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.12, right=0.96, top=0.62, bottom=0.20)
    plt.show()


def plot_payment_composition_by_presence_trajectory(
    cohort_df: pl.DataFrame | pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    title: str = "Composicion por medio de pago dentro de cada trayectoria",
    figsize: tuple[float, float] = (9.2, 4.8),
) -> None:
    if isinstance(cohort_df, pl.DataFrame):
        plot_df = cohort_df.to_pandas()
    else:
        plot_df = cohort_df.copy()

    counts = (
        plot_df.pivot_table(
            index="presence_cohort",
            columns="payment_group",
            values="n_cards",
            aggfunc="sum",
            fill_value=0,
        )
        .reindex(index=COHORT_ORDER, columns=PAYMENT_ORDER, fill_value=0)
    )
    shares = counts.div(counts.sum(axis=1), axis=0)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)
    ax.set_facecolor(FIG_BG)
    y = np.arange(len(COHORT_ORDER))
    left = np.zeros(len(COHORT_ORDER))

    for payment_group in PAYMENT_ORDER:
        values = shares[payment_group].to_numpy(dtype=float)
        ax.barh(
            y,
            values,
            left=left,
            height=0.58,
            color=PAYMENT_COLORS[payment_group],
            label=payment_group,
            edgecolor=FIG_BG,
            linewidth=1.2,
        )
        for idx, value in enumerate(values):
            ax.text(
                left[idx] + value / 2,
                y[idx],
                f"{value:.1%}",
                ha="center",
                va="center",
                fontsize=9.2,
                color="white",
                fontweight="bold",
            )
        left += values

    ax.set_yticks(y)
    ax.set_yticklabels([COHORT_LABELS[cohort] for cohort in COHORT_ORDER])
    ax.invert_yaxis()
    ax.set_xlim(0, 1)
    ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(PercentFormatter(1.0))
    ax.set_xlabel("Porcentaje de tarjetas dentro de cada trayectoria")
    style_axis(ax, grid_axis="x")
    ax.legend(
        loc="lower center",
        bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 1.02),
        ncol=2,
        title="Medio de pago",
        title_fontsize=9.5,
        fontsize=9.5,
    )

    add_figure_title(fig, title, y=0.97)
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.17, right=0.97, top=0.74, bottom=0.16)
    plt.show()
```

# Bloque 1 - Composicion BIP vs QR

## Pregunta

Cuantas tarjetas y viajes son BIP vs QR?

El objetivo es verificar si QR pesa distinto cuando miramos tarjetas que cuando
miramos viajes. Si QR tiene menor share en viajes que en tarjetas, eso sugiere
menor intensidad promedio de uso por tarjeta QR.

## 1.1 Tabla de composicion

```{python}
#| label: block1-composition-table
print("label: block1-composition-table")

composition = composition_for_lazyframe(lf_cards, "alta_n3", "Alta, n>=3").select(
    [
        "payment_group",
        "n_cards",
        "card_share",
        "n_trips",
        "trip_share",
        "trip_minus_card_share",
        "mean_trips_per_card",
        "median_trips_per_card",
    ]
)

composition
```

## 1.2 Visual: share de tarjetas vs share de viajes

```{python}
#| label: block1-composition-plot
print("label: block1-composition-plot")

plot_composition_donuts(
    composition,
    title="Composicion BIP vs QR: tarjetas y viajes",
)
```

## 1.3 Sensibilidad visual por universo

Esta celda replica la visualizacion anterior para los universos de sensibilidad.
Por defecto no se ejecuta para mantener el notebook liviano. Para activarla,
cambiar `RUN_SENS_GRAPHS = True` en la configuracion.

```{python}
#| label: block1-composition-sensitivity-plot
print("label: block1-composition-sensitivity-plot")

if RUN_SENS_GRAPHS:
    for universe in UNIVERSES:
        if universe["universe"] == "alta_n3":
            sens_composition = composition
        else:
            sens_composition = composition_for_lazyframe(
                pl.scan_parquet(universe["path"]),
                universe["universe"],
                universe["label"],
            ).select(composition.columns)

        plot_df = sens_composition.to_pandas().set_index("payment_group").loc[PAYMENT_ORDER]
        qr_card_share = plot_df.loc["QR", "card_share"]
        qr_trip_share = plot_df.loc["QR", "trip_share"]
        delta = qr_trip_share - qr_card_share

        plot_composition_donuts(
            sens_composition,
            title=f"Composicion BIP vs QR: {universe['label']}",
            subtitle=(
                f"QR representa {qr_card_share:.1%} de las tarjetas y {qr_trip_share:.1%} de los viajes "
                f"(diferencia viajes - tarjetas: {delta:+.1%})."
            ),
        )
else:
    print("Sensibilidad visual omitida. Activar con RUN_SENS_GRAPHS = True.")
```

## 1.4 Primera aparicion observada

Pregunta: la menor intensidad QR puede explicarse porque muchas tarjetas QR
aparecen mas tarde en la ventana observada?

Este grafico usa `first_trip_ts` del panel interanual y lo filtra al mismo
universo `alta_n3`. No mide el mes de adopcion durante todo el ano calendario:
se lee como primera aparicion dentro de las ventanas interanuales observadas.

```{python}
#| label: block1-first-seen-month-plot
print("label: block1-first-seen-month-plot")

first_seen_month = first_seen_month_for_lazyframe(
    lf_cards,
    INTERANNUAL_PANEL_PATH,
    "alta_n3",
    "Alta, n>=3",
)

plot_first_seen_month_distribution(
    first_seen_month,
    title="Primera aparicion observada por grupo de pago",
)
```

## 1.5 Viajes segun tiempo observado

Pregunta: a igual cantidad de semanas observadas disponibles, QR sigue teniendo
menos viajes por tarjeta?

El eje X cuenta semanas observadas del panel desde la primera aparicion de la
tarjeta hasta el cierre de la ventana. No son semanas calendario continuas.

```{python}
#| label: block1-trips-by-observed-exposure-plot
print("label: block1-trips-by-observed-exposure-plot")

observed_exposure_summary = observed_exposure_summary_for_lazyframe(
    lf_cards,
    INTERANNUAL_PANEL_PATH,
    TRIP_WEEKS,
    "alta_n3",
    "Alta, n>=3",
)

plot_trips_by_observed_exposure(
    observed_exposure_summary,
    title="Viajes por tarjeta segun tiempo observado",
)
```

## 1.6 Intensidad ajustada por actividad

Pregunta: la diferencia QR-BIP aparece porque QR esta activo en menos semanas o
porque, cuando esta activo, tambien viaja menos?

La primera metrica incluye semanas observadas sin uso. La segunda condiciona en
semanas con actividad de la tarjeta.

```{python}
#| label: block1-adjusted-activity-intensity-plot
print("label: block1-adjusted-activity-intensity-plot")

adjusted_activity_summary = adjusted_activity_summary_for_lazyframe(
    lf_cards,
    INTERANNUAL_PANEL_PATH,
    TRIP_WEEKS,
    "alta_n3",
    "Alta, n>=3",
)

plot_adjusted_activity_summary(
    adjusted_activity_summary,
    title="Intensidad de uso condicionada por tiempo observado y actividad",
)
```

## 1.7 Finding: intensidad y tiempo observado

La menor intensidad agregada de QR parece explicarse parcialmente por composicion
temporal: una mayor proporcion de tarjetas QR aparece por primera vez en la
ventana observada de 2025. Esto no debe leerse como fecha real de adopcion o
creacion de tarjeta, sino como primera aparicion dentro del panel disponible.

Al comparar tarjetas con el mismo numero de semanas observadas disponibles, QR
no queda sistematicamente muy por debajo de BIP. La diferencia que persiste es
moderada y aparece con mas claridad en viajes por semana activa que en numero de
semanas activas. En otras palabras, QR no parece ser simplemente "mas nuevo";
tambien muestra una intensidad condicional algo menor cuando la tarjeta esta
activa.

# Bloque 2 - Cohorte temporal 2024 / 2025

## Pregunta

La clasificacion se deriva de `share_trips_2025`:

- `only_2024`: tarjetas con todos sus viajes observados en 2024.
- `both_years`: tarjetas con viajes observados en 2024 y 2025.
- `only_2025`: tarjetas con todos sus viajes observados en 2025.

Esta clasificacion describe presencia temporal de tarjetas, no adopcion
individual. Una tarjeta `only_2025` puede ser una nueva tarjeta, una tarjeta que
no aparece en la ventana 2024, o un usuario observado solo en 2025.

## 2.3 Persistencia e intensidad entre ventanas

Pregunta: QR combina una base amplia de tarjetas observadas en una sola ventana
con un grupo mas pequeno de tarjetas persistentes e intensivas?

Una tarjeta es `reobservada` si aparece tanto en la ventana 2024 como en la
ventana 2025. El top 20% se calcula, por grupo de pago, solo entre tarjetas
reobservadas y usando el numero de viajes de cada ventana. Los empates en el
umbral se conservan, por lo que el grupo efectivo puede superar levemente 20%.

`Solo 2025` significa que la tarjeta no fue observada en la ventana 2024. No
implica que sea una tarjeta nueva ni que una tarjeta ausente haya sido
abandonada.
