```{python}
    ax.set_xlim(0, 1)
    ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(PercentFormatter(1.0))
    ax.set_xlabel("Composicion dentro de cada grupo")
    ax.set_ylabel("")
    style_axis(ax, grid_axis="x")
    ax.set_axisbelow(True)

axes[0].invert_yaxis()
add_figure_title(fig, "Composicion modal segun ponderacion", y=0.98)
fig.legend(
    handles=axes[0].get_legend_handles_labels()[0],
    labels=axes[0].get_legend_handles_labels()[1],
    loc="lower center",
    bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 0.01),
    ncol=3,
    fontsize=10,
)
fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.09, right=0.98, top=0.78, bottom=0.25, wspace=0.12)
plt.show()
```

## 7.2 Concentracion modal por tarjeta

Los promedios del subbloque anterior pueden ocultar perfiles distintos entre
tarjetas. Para describir esa heterogeneidad calculamos, para cada tarjeta:

- **Modo principal:** categoria con la mayor proporcion de viajes.
- **Peso del modo principal:** proporcion de viajes correspondiente a esa
  categoria.
- **Predominio claro:** el modo principal alcanza al menos 50% y no esta
  empatado con otra categoria.
- **Sin predominio claro:** ninguna categoria alcanza el umbral de forma
  unica.

Estas medidas describen concentracion observada en la tarjeta. No identifican
una preferencia estable de la persona asociada a ella.

### 7.2.1 Peso del modo principal

```{python}
#| label: block7-modal-specialization-concentration
print("label: block7-modal-specialization-concentration")

MODAL_SHARE_COLUMNS = [
    "share_trips_solo_bus",
    "share_trips_solo_metro",
    "share_trips_metro_bus",
]

modal_card_profile = (
    add_payment_group(lf_cards)
    .select(
        [
            "id_tarjeta",
            "payment_group",
            "n_viajes",
            *MODAL_SHARE_COLUMNS,
        ]
    )
    .with_columns(
        pl.max_horizontal(MODAL_SHARE_COLUMNS).alias("dominant_modal_share")
    )
    .with_columns(
        pl.sum_horizontal(
            [
                (pl.col(column) == pl.col("dominant_modal_share"))
                .cast(pl.Int8)
                for column in MODAL_SHARE_COLUMNS
            ]
        ).alias("n_dominant_ties")
    )
    .with_columns(
        (
            (pl.col("dominant_modal_share") >= 0.50)
            & (pl.col("n_dominant_ties") == 1)
        ).alias("has_clear_modal_dominance")
    )
    .with_columns(
        pl.when(
            pl.col("has_clear_modal_dominance")
            & (
                pl.col("share_trips_solo_bus")
                == pl.col("dominant_modal_share")
            )
        )
        .then(pl.lit("Predominio solo bus"))
        .when(
            pl.col("has_clear_modal_dominance")
            & (
                pl.col("share_trips_solo_metro")
                == pl.col("dominant_modal_share")
            )
        )
        .then(pl.lit("Predominio solo Metro/ferroviario"))
        .when(
            pl.col("has_clear_modal_dominance")
            & (
                pl.col("share_trips_metro_bus")
                == pl.col("dominant_modal_share")
            )
        )
        .then(pl.lit("Predominio bus + Metro/ferroviario"))
        .otherwise(pl.lit("Sin predominio claro"))
        .alias("modal_dominance_type")
    )
)

modal_specialization_summary = (
    modal_card_profile.group_by("payment_group")
    .agg(
        [
            pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
            pl.col("dominant_modal_share").quantile(0.25).alias("p25_dominant_share"),
            pl.col("dominant_modal_share").median().alias("median_dominant_share"),
            pl.col("dominant_modal_share").quantile(0.75).alias("p75_dominant_share"),
            pl.col("has_clear_modal_dominance")
            .cast(pl.Float64)
            .mean()
            .alias("share_clear_dominance"),
            (pl.col("dominant_modal_share") >= 0.75)
            .cast(pl.Float64)
            .mean()
            .alias("share_high_dominance"),
        ]
    )
    .with_columns(
        pl.col("payment_group")
        .replace_strict({"BIP": 1, "QR": 2})
        .alias("payment_order")
    )
    .sort("payment_order")
    .collect()
)

modal_specialization_display = (
    modal_specialization_summary.select(
        [
            "payment_group",
            "n_cards",
            "p25_dominant_share",
            "median_dominant_share",
            "p75_dominant_share",
            "share_clear_dominance",
            "share_high_dominance",
        ]
    )
    .rename(
        {
            "payment_group": "grupo_pago",
            "n_cards": "tarjetas",
            "p25_dominant_share": "p25_peso_modo_principal",
            "median_dominant_share": "mediana_peso_modo_principal",
            "p75_dominant_share": "p75_peso_modo_principal",
            "share_clear_dominance": "predominio_claro_50pct",
            "share_high_dominance": "concentracion_alta_75pct",
        }
    )
    .to_pandas()
)

display(
    modal_specialization_display.style.hide(axis="index").format(
        {
            "tarjetas": fmt_int,
            "p25_peso_modo_principal": "{:.1%}",
            "mediana_peso_modo_principal": "{:.1%}",
            "p75_peso_modo_principal": "{:.1%}",
            "predominio_claro_50pct": "{:.1%}",
            "concentracion_alta_75pct": "{:.1%}",
        }
    )
)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9.5, 3.8))
y_positions = {"BIP": 1, "QR": 0}

for row in modal_specialization_summary.iter_rows(named=True):
    group = row["payment_group"]
    y_pos = y_positions[group]
    ax.hlines(
        y_pos,
        row["p25_dominant_share"],
        row["p75_dominant_share"],
        color=PAYMENT_COLORS[group],
        linewidth=5,
        alpha=0.45,
    )
    ax.scatter(
        row["median_dominant_share"],
        y_pos,
        s=90,
        color=PAYMENT_COLORS[group],
        edgecolor="white",
        linewidth=1.2,
        zorder=3,
    )
    label_on_right = row["median_dominant_share"] <= 0.90
    ax.text(
        row["median_dominant_share"] + (0.025 if label_on_right else -0.025),
        y_pos,
        f"{row['median_dominant_share']:.1%}",
        ha="left" if label_on_right else "right",
        va="center",
        color=PAYMENT_COLORS[group],
        fontweight="bold",
    )

ax.set_yticks([1, 0], ["BIP", "QR"])
ax.set_xlim(0, 1)
ax.set_ylim(-0.55, 1.55)
ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(PercentFormatter(1.0))
ax.set_xlabel("Peso del modo principal por tarjeta")
ax.set_ylabel("")
style_axis(ax, grid_axis="x")
add_figure_title(fig, "Concentracion en el modo principal", y=0.96)
fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.12, right=0.96, top=0.76, bottom=0.20)
plt.show()
```

La linea muestra el rango intercuartil y el punto muestra la mediana. El umbral
de 50% se utiliza para clasificar predominio, pero no reemplaza la distribucion
continua del peso principal.

### 7.2.3 Sensibilidad al numero de viajes observados

Con pocas observaciones es mas facil que una categoria alcance una proporcion
alta por construccion. Por eso repetimos la clasificacion dentro de cuatro
rangos de viajes y comparamos BIP y QR solo dentro del mismo nivel de soporte.

## 7.3 Intermodalidad dentro y entre viajes

La categoria `Bus + Metro/ferroviario` identifica intermodalidad **dentro de
un mismo viaje**. Sin embargo, una tarjeta tambien puede utilizar ambas redes
en viajes separados: por ejemplo, registrar al menos un viaje `Solo bus` y
otro `Solo Metro/ferroviario`, sin combinarlos necesariamente en el mismo
desplazamiento.

Para separar ambos comportamientos definimos:

- **Intermodalidad dentro del viaje:** la tarjeta registra al menos un viaje
  `Bus + Metro/ferroviario`.
- **Diversidad entre viajes:** la tarjeta registra al menos un viaje `Solo
  bus` y al menos uno `Solo Metro/ferroviario`.

Ambos indicadores pueden coexistir en una misma tarjeta. La unidad de
analisis sigue siendo la tarjeta y las medidas describen los viajes
observados; no permiten vincular tarjetas pertenecientes a una misma persona.

### 7.3.1 Viajes combinados dentro de la tarjeta

Primero medimos el margen extensivo (tarjetas con al menos un viaje combinado)
y el margen intensivo (peso promedio de esos viajes dentro de cada tarjeta).
La mediana condicional se calcula solo entre las tarjetas que registraron al
menos un viaje combinado.

```{python}
#| label: block7-intermodality-within-trip
print("label: block7-intermodality-within-trip")

modal_intermodality_card = (
    modal_card_profile.with_columns(
        [
            (pl.col("share_trips_solo_bus") > 0).alias("has_solo_bus_trip"),
            (pl.col("share_trips_solo_metro") > 0).alias("has_solo_rail_trip"),
            (pl.col("share_trips_metro_bus") > 0).alias("has_mixed_trip"),
        ]
    )
    .with_columns(
        (
            pl.col("has_solo_bus_trip")
            & pl.col("has_solo_rail_trip")
        ).alias("has_separate_bus_and_rail")
    )
    .with_columns(
        pl.when(
            ~pl.col("has_mixed_trip")
            & ~pl.col("has_separate_bus_and_rail")
        )
        .then(pl.lit("Un solo modo observado"))
        .when(
            ~pl.col("has_mixed_trip")
            & pl.col("has_separate_bus_and_rail")
        )
        .then(pl.lit("Ambos modos en viajes separados"))
        .when(
            pl.col("has_mixed_trip")
            & ~pl.col("has_separate_bus_and_rail")
        )
        .then(pl.lit("Intermodalidad dentro del viaje"))
        .otherwise(pl.lit("Ambos patrones"))
        .alias("intermodality_pattern")
    )
)

modal_within_trip_summary = (
    modal_intermodality_card.group_by("payment_group")
    .agg(
        [
            pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
            pl.col("has_mixed_trip")
            .cast(pl.Float64)
            .mean()
            .alias("share_cards_with_mixed_trip"),
            pl.col("share_trips_metro_bus")
            .mean()
            .alias("mean_share_mixed_trip"),
            pl.when(pl.col("has_mixed_trip"))
            .then(pl.col("share_trips_metro_bus"))
            .otherwise(None)
            .median()
            .alias("median_share_mixed_when_present"),
        ]
    )
    .with_columns(
        pl.col("payment_group")
        .replace_strict({"BIP": 1, "QR": 2})
        .alias("payment_order")
    )
    .sort("payment_order")
    .collect()
)

modal_within_trip_display = (
    modal_within_trip_summary.select(
        [
            "payment_group",
            "n_cards",
            "share_cards_with_mixed_trip",
            "mean_share_mixed_trip",
            "median_share_mixed_when_present",
        ]
    )
    .rename(
        {
            "payment_group": "grupo_pago",
            "n_cards": "tarjetas",
            "share_cards_with_mixed_trip": "tarjetas_con_algun_viaje_combinado",
            "mean_share_mixed_trip": "proporcion_promedio_viajes_combinados",
            "median_share_mixed_when_present": "mediana_viajes_combinados_si_existen",
        }
    )
    .to_pandas()
)

display(
    modal_within_trip_display.style.hide(axis="index").format(
        {
            "tarjetas": fmt_int,
            "tarjetas_con_algun_viaje_combinado": "{:.1%}",
            "proporcion_promedio_viajes_combinados": "{:.1%}",
            "mediana_viajes_combinados_si_existen": "{:.1%}",
        }
    )
)

within_trip_plot_specs = [
    (
        "share_cards_with_mixed_trip",
        "Tarjetas con algun viaje combinado",
    ),
    (
        "mean_share_mixed_trip",
        "Peso promedio de viajes combinados",
    ),
]

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12.5, 4.0), sharey=True)
y_positions = np.array([1, 0])

for ax, (column, panel_title) in zip(axes, within_trip_plot_specs):
    panel_df = (
        modal_within_trip_summary.select(["payment_group", column])
        .to_pandas()
        .set_index("payment_group")
        .loc[PAYMENT_ORDER]
    )
    values = panel_df[column].to_numpy(dtype=float)

    ax.plot(
        values,
        y_positions,
        color="#C9C4B9",
        linewidth=3.0,

    )
    for y_pos, payment_group, value in zip(

    ):
        ax.scatter(

    ax.set_ylabel("")
    style_axis(ax, grid_axis="x")

add_figure_title(fig, "Intermodalidad dentro del viaje", y=0.98)
fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.10, right=0.98, top=0.76, bottom=0.18, wspace=0.18)
plt.show()
```

### 7.3.2 Tipologia de uso de ambas redes

Los dos indicadores anteriores generan cuatro categorias mutuamente
excluyentes:

- **Un solo modo observado:** todos los viajes clasificados son solo bus o
  todos son solo ferroviarios.
- **Ambos modos en viajes separados:** existe al menos un viaje solo bus y
  otro solo ferroviario, pero ninguno combinado.
- **Intermodalidad dentro del viaje:** existe algun viaje combinado, pero no
  aparecen simultaneamente viajes solo bus y solo ferroviarios.
- **Ambos patrones:** la tarjeta presenta viajes combinados y tambien viajes
  solo bus y solo ferroviarios.

```{python}
#| label: block7-intermodality-patterns
print("label: block7-intermodality-patterns")

INTERMODALITY_PATTERN_SPECS = [
    ("Un solo modo observado", "share_single_mode", "#D9A441"),
    (
        "Ambos modos en viajes separados",
        "share_separate_modes",
        "#9FB7B3",
    ),
    (
        "Intermodalidad dentro del viaje",
        "share_within_trip_only",

    ),
    ("Ambos patrones", "share_both_patterns", "#2F8F73"),
]

modal_intermodality_patterns = (
    modal_intermodality_card.group_by("payment_group")
    .agg(
        [
            pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
            *[
                (pl.col("intermodality_pattern") == pattern_label)
                .cast(pl.Float64)
                .mean()
                .alias(column)
                for pattern_label, column, _ in INTERMODALITY_PATTERN_SPECS
            ],
        ]
    )
    .with_columns(
        pl.col("payment_group")
        .replace_strict({"BIP": 1, "QR": 2})

)

modal_intermodality_patterns_display = (
    modal_intermodality_patterns.select(

            *[column for _, column, _ in INTERMODALITY_PATTERN_SPECS],
        ]
    )
    .rename(
        {
            "payment_group": "grupo_pago",
            "n_cards": "tarjetas",
            "share_single_mode": "un_solo_modo_observado",
            "share_separate_modes": "ambos_modos_en_viajes_separados",
            "share_within_trip_only": "intermodalidad_dentro_del_viaje",
            "share_both_patterns": "ambos_patrones",
        }
    )
    .to_pandas()
)

display(
    modal_intermodality_patterns_display.style.hide(axis="index").format(
        {
            "tarjetas": fmt_int,
            "un_solo_modo_observado": "{:.1%}",
            "ambos_modos_en_viajes_separados": "{:.1%}",

        }

)

pattern_plot_df = (
    modal_intermodality_patterns.select(
        [
            "payment_group",

    .set_index("payment_group")
    .loc[PAYMENT_ORDER]
)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11.5, 4.2))
y_positions = np.array([1, 0])
left = np.zeros(len(PAYMENT_ORDER))

for pattern_label, column, color in INTERMODALITY_PATTERN_SPECS:
    values = pattern_plot_df[column].to_numpy(dtype=float)
```

### 7.3.3 Sensibilidad al numero de viajes observados

La probabilidad de observar un viaje combinado o viajes de ambos modos crece
mecanicamente al aumentar el numero de viajes de una tarjeta. Por eso
comparamos BIP y QR dentro de los mismos rangos de soporte.

```{python}
#| label: block7-intermodality-trip-sensitivity
print("label: block7-intermodality-trip-sensitivity")

modal_intermodality_by_trip_bin = (
    modal_intermodality_card.with_columns(
        [
            pl.when(pl.col("n_viajes") <= 5)
            .then(pl.lit("3-5"))
            .when(pl.col("n_viajes") <= 10)
            .then(pl.lit("6-10"))
            .when(pl.col("n_viajes") <= 20)
            .then(pl.lit("11-20"))
            .otherwise(pl.lit("21+"))
            .alias("trip_bin"),
            pl.when(pl.col("n_viajes") <= 5)
            .then(1)
            .when(pl.col("n_viajes") <= 10)
            .then(2)
            .when(pl.col("n_viajes") <= 20)
            .then(3)
            .otherwise(4)
            .cast(pl.Int8)
            .alias("trip_bin_order"),
        ]
    )
    .group_by(["payment_group", "trip_bin", "trip_bin_order"])
    .agg(
        [
            pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
            pl.col("has_mixed_trip")
            .cast(pl.Float64)
            .mean()
            .alias("share_cards_with_mixed_trip"),
            pl.col("has_separate_bus_and_rail")
            .cast(pl.Float64)
            .mean()
            .alias("share_cards_with_separate_modes"),
        ]
    )
    .with_columns(
        pl.col("payment_group")
        .replace_strict({"BIP": 1, "QR": 2})
        .alias("payment_order")
    )
    .sort(["trip_bin_order", "payment_order"])
    .collect()
)

modal_intermodality_bin_display = (
    modal_intermodality_by_trip_bin.select(
        [
            "trip_bin",
            "payment_group",
            "n_cards",
            "share_cards_with_mixed_trip",
            "share_cards_with_separate_modes",
        ]
    )
    .rename(
        {
            "trip_bin": "viajes_observados",
            "payment_group": "grupo_pago",
            "n_cards": "tarjetas",
            "share_cards_with_mixed_trip": "tarjetas_con_viaje_combinado",

)

display(
```

### 7.3.4 Sensibilidad territorial de la intermodalidad

La diferencia anterior puede reflejar que BIP y QR circulan por pares
origen-destino distintos. Para separar esa composicion territorial del patron
modal, comparamos la proporcion de viajes `Bus + Metro/ferroviario` dentro de
los mismos OD dirigidos (`zona_inicio_viaje` -> `zona_fin_viaje`).

La comparacion principal conserva solo pares con al menos 100 viajes BIP y 100
viajes QR. Primero calculamos la brecha usando la composicion observada de cada
grupo dentro de esos OD. Luego aplicamos a BIP y QR la misma ponderacion OD,
definida por el volumen conjunto del par. Si la brecha se reduce, parte de la
diferencia agregada se asocia a que ambos grupos circulan por territorios
distintos. Si permanece, la composicion OD observada no basta para explicarla.

Este ajuste sigue siendo descriptivo: compara viajes entre zonas semejantes,
pero no controla recorridos exactos, oferta de transporte, horario ni eleccion
individual del modo.

```{python}
#| label: block7-intermodality-od-sensitivity
print("label: block7-intermodality-od-sensitivity")

OD_ORIGIN_COL = "zona_inicio_viaje"
OD_DESTINATION_COL = "zona_fin_viaje"
OD_MIN_TRIPS_PER_PAYMENT = 100

modal_trip_od_lf = pl.concat(
    [
        pl.scan_parquet(path).select(
            [
                "id_tarjeta",
                OD_ORIGIN_COL,
                OD_DESTINATION_COL,
                *MODAL_STAGE_COLS,
            ]
        )
        for path in TRIP_PATHS
    ],
    how="vertical_relaxed",
).join(card_payment_lookup, on="id_tarjeta", how="inner")

od_stage_exprs = [
    pl.col(column).cast(pl.Utf8, strict=False).str.strip_chars()
    for column in MODAL_STAGE_COLS
]
od_has_observed_mode = pl.any_horizontal(
    [expr.is_not_null() & expr.ne("") for expr in od_stage_exprs]
)
od_has_unexpected_mode = pl.any_horizontal(
    [
        expr.is_not_null()
        & expr.ne("")
        & ~expr.is_in(EXPECTED_MODE_CODES)
        for expr in od_stage_exprs
    ]
)

modal_trip_od_lf = (
    modal_trip_od_lf.with_columns(
        [
            any_modal_code(od_stage_exprs, BUS_MODE_CODES).alias("has_bus"),
            any_modal_code(od_stage_exprs, RAIL_MODE_CODES).alias("has_rail"),
            od_has_observed_mode.alias("has_observed_mode"),
            od_has_unexpected_mode.alias("has_unexpected_mode"),
            pl.col(OD_ORIGIN_COL).str.strip_chars().alias("origin_zone"),
            pl.col(OD_DESTINATION_COL).str.strip_chars().alias("destination_zone"),
        ]
    )
    .filter(
        pl.col("has_observed_mode")
        & ~pl.col("has_unexpected_mode")
        & (pl.col("has_bus") | pl.col("has_rail"))
        & pl.col("origin_zone").is_not_null()
        & pl.col("origin_zone").ne("")
        & pl.col("destination_zone").is_not_null()
        & pl.col("destination_zone").ne("")
    )
    .with_columns(
        (pl.col("has_bus") & pl.col("has_rail")).alias("is_bus_rail")
    )
    .select(
        [
            "id_tarjeta",
            "payment_group",
            "origin_zone",
            "destination_zone",
            "is_bus_rail",
        ]
    )
)

modal_od_cells = (
    modal_trip_od_lf.group_by(
        ["origin_zone", "destination_zone", "payment_group"]
    )
    .agg(
        [
            pl.len().alias("n_trips"),
            pl.col("is_bus_rail").sum().alias("n_combined_trips"),
        ]
    )
    .with_columns(
        (pl.col("n_combined_trips") / pl.col("n_trips")).alias(
            "combined_trip_rate"
        )
    )
    .collect()
)

modal_od_bip = modal_od_cells.filter(
    pl.col("payment_group") == "BIP"
).select(
    [
        "origin_zone",
        "destination_zone",
        pl.col("n_trips").alias("n_trips_bip"),
        pl.col("n_combined_trips").alias("n_combined_bip"),
        pl.col("combined_trip_rate").alias("rate_bip"),
    ]
)
modal_od_qr = modal_od_cells.filter(
    pl.col("payment_group") == "QR"
).select(
    [
        "origin_zone",
        "destination_zone",
        pl.col("n_trips").alias("n_trips_qr"),
        pl.col("n_combined_trips").alias("n_combined_qr"),
        pl.col("combined_trip_rate").alias("rate_qr"),
    ]
)

modal_od_overlap = (
    modal_od_bip.join(
        modal_od_qr,
        on=["origin_zone", "destination_zone"],
        how="inner",
    )
    .with_columns(
        (pl.col("n_trips_bip") + pl.col("n_trips_qr")).alias(
            "n_trips_pooled"
        )
    )
)

modal_od_shared = (
    modal_od_overlap
    .filter(
        (pl.col("n_trips_bip") >= OD_MIN_TRIPS_PER_PAYMENT)
        & (pl.col("n_trips_qr") >= OD_MIN_TRIPS_PER_PAYMENT)
    )
)

if modal_od_shared.is_empty():
    raise ValueError(
        "No hay pares OD con soporte suficiente en ambos medios de pago."
    )

classified_trip_totals = {
    row["payment_group"]: int(row["n_classified"])
    for row in modal_coverage_audit.filter(
        pl.col("payment_group").is_in(PAYMENT_ORDER)
    ).iter_rows(named=True)
}

raw_od_summary = (
    modal_od_cells.group_by("payment_group")
    .agg(
        [
            pl.col("n_trips").sum().alias("n_trips"),
            pl.col("n_combined_trips").sum().alias("n_combined_trips"),
        ]
    )
    .with_columns(
        (pl.col("n_combined_trips") / pl.col("n_trips")).alias(
            "combined_trip_rate"
        )
    )
)
raw_od_metrics = {
    row["payment_group"]: row
    for row in raw_od_summary.iter_rows(named=True)
}

shared_metrics = modal_od_shared.select(
    [
        pl.len().alias("n_od"),
        pl.col("n_trips_bip").sum().alias("n_trips_bip"),
        pl.col("n_trips_qr").sum().alias("n_trips_qr"),
        pl.col("n_combined_bip").sum().alias("n_combined_bip"),
        pl.col("n_combined_qr").sum().alias("n_combined_qr"),
        pl.col("n_trips_pooled").sum().alias("n_trips_pooled"),
    ]
).row(0, named=True)

shared_raw_rate_bip = (
    shared_metrics["n_combined_bip"] / shared_metrics["n_trips_bip"]
)
shared_raw_rate_qr = (
    shared_metrics["n_combined_qr"] / shared_metrics["n_trips_qr"]
)

modal_od_shared_weighted = modal_od_shared.with_columns(
    (
        pl.col("n_trips_pooled") / shared_metrics["n_trips_pooled"]
    ).alias("common_od_weight")
)
adjusted_rate_bip = modal_od_shared_weighted.select(
    (pl.col("common_od_weight") * pl.col("rate_bip")).sum()
).item()
adjusted_rate_qr = modal_od_shared_weighted.select(
    (pl.col("common_od_weight") * pl.col("rate_qr")).sum()
).item()

n_all_od = modal_od_cells.select(
    ["origin_zone", "destination_zone"]
).unique().height
raw_coverage_bip = (
    raw_od_metrics["BIP"]["n_trips"] / classified_trip_totals["BIP"]
)
raw_coverage_qr = (
    raw_od_metrics["QR"]["n_trips"] / classified_trip_totals["QR"]
)
shared_coverage_bip = (
    shared_metrics["n_trips_bip"] / classified_trip_totals["BIP"]
)
shared_coverage_qr = (
    shared_metrics["n_trips_qr"] / classified_trip_totals["QR"]
)

modal_od_sensitivity = pl.DataFrame(
    {
        "comparison": [
            "Todos los OD validos",
            "OD compartidos, composicion propia",
            "OD compartidos, ponderacion comun",
        ],
        "n_od": [
            n_all_od,
            shared_metrics["n_od"],
            shared_metrics["n_od"],
        ],
        "coverage_bip": [
            raw_coverage_bip,
            shared_coverage_bip,
            shared_coverage_bip,
        ],
        "coverage_qr": [
            raw_coverage_qr,
            shared_coverage_qr,
            shared_coverage_qr,
        ],
        "rate_bip": [
            raw_od_metrics["BIP"]["combined_trip_rate"],
            shared_raw_rate_bip,
            adjusted_rate_bip,
        ],
        "rate_qr": [
            raw_od_metrics["QR"]["combined_trip_rate"],
            shared_raw_rate_qr,
            adjusted_rate_qr,
        ],
    }
).with_columns(
    (100 * (pl.col("rate_bip") - pl.col("rate_qr"))).alias(
        "gap_bip_qr_pp"
    )
)

modal_od_sensitivity_display = (
    modal_od_sensitivity.rename(
        {
            "comparison": "comparacion",
            "n_od": "pares_od",
            "coverage_bip": "cobertura_viajes_bip",
            "coverage_qr": "cobertura_viajes_qr",
            "rate_bip": "viajes_combinados_bip",
            "rate_qr": "viajes_combinados_qr",
            "gap_bip_qr_pp": "diferencia_bip_qr_pp",
        }
    ).to_pandas()
)

display(
    modal_od_sensitivity_display.style.hide(axis="index").format(
        {
            "pares_od": fmt_int,
            "cobertura_viajes_bip": "{:.1%}",
            "cobertura_viajes_qr": "{:.1%}",
            "viajes_combinados_bip": "{:.1%}",
            "viajes_combinados_qr": "{:.1%}",
            "diferencia_bip_qr_pp": "{:+.1f}",
        }
    )
)

comparison_plot_df = (
    modal_od_sensitivity.filter(
        pl.col("comparison").is_in(
            [
                "OD compartidos, composicion propia",
                "OD compartidos, ponderacion comun",
            ]
        )
    )
    .with_columns(
        pl.col("comparison").replace_strict(
            {
                "OD compartidos, composicion propia": "Observada",
                "OD compartidos, ponderacion comun": "OD comun",
            }
        ).alias("comparison_label")
    )
    .to_pandas()
)

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12.5, 4.2))
x_positions = np.arange(len(comparison_plot_df))

for payment_group, column in [("BIP", "rate_bip"), ("QR", "rate_qr")]:
    values = comparison_plot_df[column].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    axes[0].plot(
        x_positions,
        values,
        marker="o",
        linewidth=2.0,
        markersize=6.5,
        color=PAYMENT_COLORS[payment_group],
        label=payment_group,
    )
    for x_pos, value in zip(x_positions, values):
        axes[0].text(
            x_pos,
            value + (0.008 if payment_group == "BIP" else -0.008),
            f"{value:.1%}",
            ha="center",
            va="center",
            fontsize=9,
            fontweight="bold",
            color=PAYMENT_COLORS[payment_group],
        )

axes[0].set_title("Viajes combinados dentro de OD compartidos")
axes[0].set_xticks(x_positions, comparison_plot_df["comparison_label"])
axes[0].set_ylim(bottom=0)
axes[0].yaxis.set_major_formatter(PercentFormatter(1.0))
axes[0].set_xlabel("")
axes[0].set_ylabel("Porcentaje de viajes")
style_axis(axes[0], grid_axis="y")

gap_values = comparison_plot_df["gap_bip_qr_pp"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
axes[1].plot(
    x_positions,
    gap_values,
    marker="o",
    linewidth=2.5,
    markersize=7,
    color="#7A7F78",
)
axes[1].axhline(0, color=NEUTRAL_LINE, linewidth=1.0)
for x_pos, value in zip(x_positions, gap_values):
    axes[1].text(
        x_pos,

        f"{value:+.1f} pp",
        ha="center",

axes[1].set_title("Brecha BIP - QR")
axes[1].set_xticks(x_positions, comparison_plot_df["comparison_label"])

add_figure_title(fig, "Intermodalidad ajustada por origen-destino", y=0.98)

    handles=payment_legend_handles(),
    loc="lower center",

    ncol=2,
    fontsize=10,
)
fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.08, right=0.98, top=0.76, bottom=0.25, wspace=0.20)
plt.show()

print(
    "Soporte principal: "
    f">={OD_MIN_TRIPS_PER_PAYMENT} viajes por medio en cada OD; "

)
```

### 7.3.5 Sensibilidad al soporte minimo por OD

El umbral de 100 viajes por medio reduce considerablemente la intermodalidad
observada respecto del total de viajes. Para comprobar que la lectura no
dependa de ese valor aislado, repetimos el calculo con umbrales de 25, 50, 100,
250 y 500 viajes BIP y QR por OD.

Para cada umbral se muestran dos resultados. La cobertura indica cuanto del
volumen original permanece en los OD comparables. La brecha BIP - QR se calcula
tanto con la composicion observada de cada medio como aplicando una ponderacion
OD comun. El patron seria sensible al umbral si la magnitud o el signo de la
brecha cambiaran de forma importante al mover este minimo.

```{python}
#| label: block7-intermodality-od-threshold-sensitivity
print("label: block7-intermodality-od-threshold-sensitivity")

OD_SUPPORT_THRESHOLDS = [25, 50, 100, 250, 500]
threshold_rows = []

for min_trips in OD_SUPPORT_THRESHOLDS:
    threshold_od = modal_od_overlap.filter(
        (pl.col("n_trips_bip") >= min_trips)
        & (pl.col("n_trips_qr") >= min_trips)
    )

    if threshold_od.is_empty():
        continue

    threshold_metrics = threshold_od.select(
        [
            pl.len().alias("n_od"),
            pl.col("n_trips_bip").sum().alias("n_trips_bip"),
            pl.col("n_trips_qr").sum().alias("n_trips_qr"),
            pl.col("n_combined_bip").sum().alias("n_combined_bip"),
            pl.col("n_combined_qr").sum().alias("n_combined_qr"),
            pl.col("n_trips_pooled").sum().alias("n_trips_pooled"),
        ]
    ).row(0, named=True)

    observed_rate_bip = (
        threshold_metrics["n_combined_bip"]
        / threshold_metrics["n_trips_bip"]
    )
    observed_rate_qr = (
        threshold_metrics["n_combined_qr"]
        / threshold_metrics["n_trips_qr"]
    )

    threshold_od_weighted = threshold_od.with_columns(
        (
            pl.col("n_trips_pooled")
            / threshold_metrics["n_trips_pooled"]
        ).alias("common_od_weight")
    )
    common_rate_bip = threshold_od_weighted.select(
        (pl.col("common_od_weight") * pl.col("rate_bip")).sum()
    ).item()
    common_rate_qr = threshold_od_weighted.select(
        (pl.col("common_od_weight") * pl.col("rate_qr")).sum()
    ).item()

    threshold_rows.append(
        {
            "min_trips_per_payment": min_trips,
            "n_od": threshold_metrics["n_od"],
            "coverage_bip": (
                threshold_metrics["n_trips_bip"]
                / classified_trip_totals["BIP"]
            ),
            "coverage_qr": (
                threshold_metrics["n_trips_qr"]
                / classified_trip_totals["QR"]
            ),
            "observed_rate_bip": observed_rate_bip,
            "observed_rate_qr": observed_rate_qr,
            "observed_gap_bip_qr_pp": 100
            * (observed_rate_bip - observed_rate_qr),
            "common_rate_bip": common_rate_bip,
            "common_rate_qr": common_rate_qr,
            "common_gap_bip_qr_pp": 100
            * (common_rate_bip - common_rate_qr),
        }
    )

modal_od_threshold_sensitivity = pl.DataFrame(threshold_rows).sort(
    "min_trips_per_payment"
)

modal_od_threshold_display = (
    modal_od_threshold_sensitivity.rename(
        {
            "min_trips_per_payment": "soporte_minimo_por_medio",
            "n_od": "pares_od",
            "coverage_bip": "cobertura_bip",
            "coverage_qr": "cobertura_qr",
            "observed_rate_bip": "combinados_bip_observado",
            "observed_rate_qr": "combinados_qr_observado",
            "observed_gap_bip_qr_pp": "brecha_observada_bip_qr_pp",
            "common_rate_bip": "combinados_bip_peso_comun",
            "common_rate_qr": "combinados_qr_peso_comun",
            "common_gap_bip_qr_pp": "brecha_peso_comun_bip_qr_pp",
        }
    ).to_pandas()
)

display(
    modal_od_threshold_display.style.hide(axis="index").format(
        {
            "soporte_minimo_por_medio": fmt_int,
            "pares_od": fmt_int,
            "cobertura_bip": "{:.1%}",
            "cobertura_qr": "{:.1%}",
            "combinados_bip_observado": "{:.1%}",
            "combinados_qr_observado": "{:.1%}",
            "brecha_observada_bip_qr_pp": "{:+.1f}",
            "combinados_bip_peso_comun": "{:.1%}",
            "combinados_qr_peso_comun": "{:.1%}",
            "brecha_peso_comun_bip_qr_pp": "{:+.1f}",
        }
    )
)

threshold_plot_df = modal_od_threshold_sensitivity.to_pandas()
threshold_x = threshold_plot_df["min_trips_per_payment"].to_numpy()

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12.5, 4.2))

for payment_group, column in [
    ("BIP", "coverage_bip"),
    ("QR", "coverage_qr"),
]:
    axes[0].plot(
        threshold_x,
        threshold_plot_df[column],

        markersize=6,

axes[0].set_title("Cobertura retenida")
axes[0].set_xticks(threshold_x)

axes[0].yaxis.set_major_formatter(PercentFormatter(1.0))
axes[0].set_xlabel("Viajes minimos por medio en cada OD")
axes[0].set_ylabel("Porcentaje de viajes")
axes[0].legend(frameon=False, loc="upper right")
style_axis(axes[0], grid_axis="y")

gap_specs = [

for column, label, color in gap_specs:

axes[1].axhline(0, color=NEUTRAL_LINE, linewidth=1.0)

fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.08, right=0.98, top=0.76, bottom=0.22, wspace=0.22)
plt.show()
```

## 7.4 Robustez por soporte y continuidad

Los subbloques anteriores muestran que la oportunidad de observar categorias
modales distintas aumenta con el numero de viajes. Esta comprobacion final
separa dos dimensiones:

- **Continuidad temporal:** se comparan `Amplio (>=3 viajes)`, `Persistente`
  y `Repetido`. `Persistente` exige presencia en 2024 y 2025; `Repetido`
  agrega al menos dos semanas activas en cada ano.
- **Soporte de viajes:** dentro de cada universo se ajustan BIP y QR a una
  distribucion comun de tarjetas con `3-5`, `6-10`, `11-20` y `21+` viajes.

La distribucion comun corresponde al promedio simple de las distribuciones de
BIP y QR. De este modo, ninguno de los dos grupos determina por si solo la
ponderacion. Se comparan tres indicadores calculados por tarjeta:

1. Peso promedio del modo principal.
2. Porcentaje con un solo modo observado.
3. Porcentaje con al menos un viaje combinado.

El resultado ajustado responde si las brechas se mantienen cuando BIP y QR
reciben el mismo peso relativo en cada rango de viajes. No controla diferencias
territoriales, recorridos ni oferta de transporte. Ademas, `Repetido` es un
subconjunto de `Persistente`, por lo que funciona como sensibilidad y no como
una muestra independiente.

```{python}
#| label: block7-modal-equal-support
print("label: block7-modal-equal-support")

MODAL_SUPPORT_METRICS = [
    (
        "mean_dominant_modal_share",
        "Peso promedio del modo principal",
    ),
    (
        "share_single_mode",
        "Un solo modo observado",
    ),

]
MODAL_SUPPORT_COMPARISONS = [
    ("Observado", 1, "#7A7F78"),
    ("Ajustado por viajes", 2, "#A66A3F"),
]


def add_modal_trip_bin(frame: pl.LazyFrame) -> pl.LazyFrame:
    return frame.with_columns(
        [
            pl.when(pl.col("n_viajes") <= 5)
            .then(pl.lit("3-5"))
            .when(pl.col("n_viajes") <= 10)
            .then(pl.lit("6-10"))
            .when(pl.col("n_viajes") <= 20)
            .then(pl.lit("11-20"))
            .otherwise(pl.lit("21+"))
            .alias("trip_bin"),
            pl.when(pl.col("n_viajes") <= 5)
            .then(1)
            .when(pl.col("n_viajes") <= 10)
            .then(2)
            .when(pl.col("n_viajes") <= 20)
            .then(3)
            .otherwise(4)
            .cast(pl.Int8)
            .alias("trip_bin_order"),
        ]
    )


modal_persistent_cards = modal_intermodality_card.join(
    lf_recurrent_cards.select("id_tarjeta").unique(),
    on="id_tarjeta",
    how="semi",
)
modal_repeated_cards = modal_intermodality_card.join(
    lf_repeated_cards.select("id_tarjeta").unique(),
    on="id_tarjeta",
    how="semi",
)

modal_support_universe_specs = [
    (
        "broad_n3",
        "Amplio (>=3 viajes)",
        1,
        modal_intermodality_card,
    ),
    (
        "persistent_n3",
        "Persistente",
        2,
        modal_persistent_cards,
    ),
    (
        "repeated_n3",
        "Repetido",
        3,
        modal_repeated_cards,
    ),
]

modal_support_observed_queries = []
modal_support_bin_queries = []

for (
    universe,
    universe_label,
    universe_order,
    universe_lf,
) in modal_support_universe_specs:
    modal_support_observed_queries.append(
        universe_lf.group_by("payment_group")
        .agg(
            [
                pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
                pl.col("dominant_modal_share")
                .mean()
                .alias("mean_dominant_modal_share"),

                    pl.col("intermodality_pattern")
                    == "Un solo modo observado"

                .cast(pl.Float64)
                .mean()
                .alias("share_single_mode"),
                pl.col("has_mixed_trip")
                .cast(pl.Float64)
                .mean()
                .alias("share_cards_with_mixed_trip"),
            ]
        )
        .with_columns(
            [
                pl.lit(universe).alias("universe"),
                pl.lit(universe_label).alias("universe_label"),
                pl.lit(universe_order).alias("universe_order"),
                pl.lit("Observado").alias("comparison"),
                pl.lit(1).alias("comparison_order"),
            ]
        )
    )

    modal_support_bin_queries.append(
        add_modal_trip_bin(universe_lf)
        .group_by(
            [
                "payment_group",
                "trip_bin",
                "trip_bin_order",
            ]
        )
        .agg(
            [
                pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
                pl.col("dominant_modal_share")
                .mean()
                .alias("mean_dominant_modal_share"),
                (
                    pl.col("intermodality_pattern")
                    == "Un solo modo observado"
                )
                .cast(pl.Float64)
                .mean()
                .alias("share_single_mode"),
                pl.col("has_mixed_trip")
                .cast(pl.Float64)
                .mean()
                .alias("share_cards_with_mixed_trip"),
            ]
        )
        .with_columns(
            [
                pl.lit(universe).alias("universe"),
                pl.lit(universe_label).alias("universe_label"),
                pl.lit(universe_order).alias("universe_order"),
            ]
        )
    )

modal_support_observed = pl.concat(
    modal_support_observed_queries,
    how="vertical",
).collect()
modal_support_by_bin = pl.concat(
    modal_support_bin_queries,
    how="vertical",
).collect()

modal_support_by_bin = (
    modal_support_by_bin.with_columns(
        (
            pl.col("n_cards")
            / pl.col("n_cards").sum().over(
                ["universe", "payment_group"]
            )
        ).alias("payment_bin_share")
    )
    .with_columns(
        pl.col("payment_bin_share")
        .mean()
        .over(["universe", "trip_bin"])
        .alias("common_bin_weight")
    )
)

modal_support_adjusted = (
    modal_support_by_bin.group_by(
        [
            "universe",
            "universe_label",
            "universe_order",
            "payment_group",
        ]
    )
    .agg(
        [
            pl.col("n_cards").sum().alias("n_cards"),
            *[
                (
                    pl.col(metric_column)
                    * pl.col("common_bin_weight")
                )
                .sum()
                .alias(metric_column)
                for metric_column, _ in MODAL_SUPPORT_METRICS
            ],
        ]
    )
    .with_columns(
        [
            pl.lit("Ajustado por viajes").alias("comparison"),
            pl.lit(2).alias("comparison_order"),
        ]
    )
)

# Polars concatena verticalmente por posicion; se fija el mismo orden de columnas.
modal_support_adjusted = modal_support_adjusted.select(
    modal_support_observed.columns
)

modal_support_comparison = (
    pl.concat(
        [modal_support_observed, modal_support_adjusted],
        how="vertical",
    )
    .with_columns(

        .replace_strict({"BIP": 1, "QR": 2})

    .sort(

)

modal_support_display = (

            "comparison",

        {
            "universe_label": "universo",
            "comparison": "comparacion",
            "payment_group": "grupo_pago",
            "n_cards": "tarjetas",
            "mean_dominant_modal_share": "peso_promedio_modo_principal",
            "share_single_mode": "un_solo_modo_observado",
            "share_cards_with_mixed_trip": "algun_viaje_combinado",

    )

)

display(
    modal_support_display.style.hide(axis="index").format(
        {
            "tarjetas": fmt_int,
            "peso_promedio_modo_principal": "{:.1%}",
            "un_solo_modo_observado": "{:.1%}",
            "algun_viaje_combinado": "{:.1%}",
        }
    )
)

modal_support_bip = modal_support_comparison.filter(
    pl.col("payment_group") == "BIP"
).select(
    [
        "universe",
        "universe_label",
        "universe_order",
        "comparison",
        "comparison_order",

            pl.col(column).alias(f"{column}_bip")

modal_support_qr = modal_support_comparison.filter(

            pl.col(column).alias(f"{column}_qr")

    ]

modal_support_gaps = (
    modal_support_bip.join(
        modal_support_qr,
        on=["universe", "comparison"],
        how="inner",
    )
    .with_columns(
        [
            (
                100
                * (
                    pl.col(f"{column}_qr")
                    - pl.col(f"{column}_bip")
                )
            ).alias(f"gap_{column}_pp")

    .sort(["universe_order", "comparison_order"])
)

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(14.5, 4.2), sharex=True)
x_positions = np.arange(len(modal_support_universe_specs))
universe_tick_labels = [
    universe_label.replace(" (>=3 viajes)", "")

]

for ax, (metric_column, panel_title) in zip(
    axes,

    for comparison, _, color in MODAL_SUPPORT_COMPARISONS:
```

### 7.4.1 Unimodalidad con el mismo numero de viajes

El ajuste anterior iguala la distribucion de tarjetas entre rangos de viajes,
pero dentro de cada rango las tarjetas todavia pueden tener distinta cantidad
de observaciones. Para aislar esa oportunidad de observar modos distintos,
usamos un unico conjunto de tarjetas con al menos 10 viajes y preguntamos como
se verian si observaramos exactamente 3, 5 o 10 viajes de cada una.

Para cada tarjeta calculamos la probabilidad exacta de que una muestra aleatoria
sin reemplazo contenga solamente viajes `Solo bus` o solamente viajes `Solo
Metro/ferroviario`. No se realiza una simulacion ni se utilizan los primeros
viajes: el resultado corresponde al promedio esperado sobre todas las muestras
posibles de tamano `k`.

Mantener el mismo conjunto de tarjetas en los tres tamanos evita que la
comparacion cambie de composicion al aumentar `k`. La prueba evalua oportunidad
de observacion, no una transicion conductual de la tarjeta ni diferencias
territoriales.

```{python}
#| label: block7-modal-fixed-trip-subsample
print("label: block7-modal-fixed-trip-subsample")

MODAL_FIXED_SAMPLE_SIZES = [3, 5, 10]
MODAL_FIXED_MIN_TRIPS = max(MODAL_FIXED_SAMPLE_SIZES)


def probability_single_category(
    count_column: str,
    sample_size: int,
) -> pl.Expr:
    probability = pl.lit(1.0)
    for draw_index in range(sample_size):
        remaining_category = (
            pl.col(count_column) - draw_index
        ).clip(lower_bound=0).cast(pl.Float64)
        remaining_total = (
            pl.col("n_trips_total") - draw_index
        ).cast(pl.Float64)
        probability = probability * (
            remaining_category / remaining_total
        )
    return probability


modal_fixed_support_cards = (
    add_payment_group(lf_cards)
    .filter(pl.col("n_viajes") >= MODAL_FIXED_MIN_TRIPS)
    .select(
        [
            "id_tarjeta",
            "payment_group",
            pl.col("n_viajes").cast(pl.Int64).alias("n_trips_total"),
            (
                pl.col("share_trips_solo_bus")
                * pl.col("n_viajes")
            )
            .round()
            .cast(pl.Int64)
            .alias("n_trips_solo_bus"),
            (
                pl.col("share_trips_solo_metro")
                * pl.col("n_viajes")
            )
            .round()
            .cast(pl.Int64)
            .alias("n_trips_solo_rail"),
            (
                pl.col("share_trips_metro_bus")
                * pl.col("n_viajes")
            )
            .round()
            .cast(pl.Int64)
            .alias("n_trips_combined"),
        ]
    )
)

modal_count_audit = (
    modal_fixed_support_cards.select(
        (
            pl.col("n_trips_solo_bus")
            + pl.col("n_trips_solo_rail")
            + pl.col("n_trips_combined")
            - pl.col("n_trips_total")
        )
        .abs()
        .max()
        .alias("max_count_error")
    )
    .collect()
    .item()
)

modal_fixed_k_long = pl.concat(
    [
        modal_fixed_support_cards.select(
            [
                "id_tarjeta",
                "payment_group",
                pl.lit(sample_size).alias("sample_size"),
                (
                    probability_single_category(
                        "n_trips_solo_bus",
                        sample_size,
                    )
                    + probability_single_category(
                        "n_trips_solo_rail",
                        sample_size,
                    )
                ).alias("probability_unimodal"),
            ]
        )
        for sample_size in MODAL_FIXED_SAMPLE_SIZES
    ],
    how="vertical",
)

modal_fixed_k_summary = (
    modal_fixed_k_long.group_by(
        ["sample_size", "payment_group"]
    )
    .agg(
        [
            pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
            pl.col("probability_unimodal")
            .mean()
            .alias("expected_share_unimodal"),
        ]
    )
    .collect()
)

modal_fixed_k_bip = (
    modal_fixed_k_summary.filter(
        pl.col("payment_group") == "BIP"
    )
    .select(
        [
            "sample_size",
            pl.col("n_cards").alias("n_cards_bip"),
            pl.col("expected_share_unimodal").alias(
                "expected_share_unimodal_bip"
            ),
        ]
    )
)
modal_fixed_k_qr = (
    modal_fixed_k_summary.filter(
        pl.col("payment_group") == "QR"
    )
    .select(
        [
            "sample_size",
            pl.col("n_cards").alias("n_cards_qr"),
            pl.col("expected_share_unimodal").alias(
                "expected_share_unimodal_qr"
            ),
        ]
    )
)

modal_fixed_k_comparison = (
    modal_fixed_k_bip.join(
        modal_fixed_k_qr,
        on="sample_size",
        how="inner",
    )
    .with_columns(
        (
            100
            * (
                pl.col("expected_share_unimodal_qr")
                - pl.col("expected_share_unimodal_bip")
            )
        ).alias("gap_qr_bip_pp")
    )
    .sort("sample_size")
)

modal_fixed_k_display = (
    modal_fixed_k_comparison.rename(
        {
            "sample_size": "viajes_observados_por_tarjeta",
            "n_cards_bip": "tarjetas_bip",
            "n_cards_qr": "tarjetas_qr",
            "expected_share_unimodal_bip": "unimodales_bip",
            "expected_share_unimodal_qr": "unimodales_qr",
            "gap_qr_bip_pp": "diferencia_qr_bip_pp",
        }
    )
    .to_pandas()
)

display(
    modal_fixed_k_display.style.hide(axis="index").format(
        {
            "tarjetas_bip": fmt_int,
            "tarjetas_qr": fmt_int,
            "unimodales_bip": "{:.1%}",
            "unimodales_qr": "{:.1%}",
            "diferencia_qr_bip_pp": "{:+.1f}",
        }
    )
)

fixed_k_plot_df = modal_fixed_k_comparison.to_pandas()

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8.8, 4.2))
for payment_group, column in [
    ("BIP", "expected_share_unimodal_bip"),
    ("QR", "expected_share_unimodal_qr"),
]:
    ax.plot(
        fixed_k_plot_df["sample_size"],
        fixed_k_plot_df[column],
        marker="o",
        linewidth=2.0,
        markersize=7,
        color=PAYMENT_COLORS[payment_group],
        label=payment_group,
    )

ax.set_xticks(MODAL_FIXED_SAMPLE_SIZES)
ax.set_ylim(0, 0.70)
ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(PercentFormatter(1.0))
ax.set_xlabel("Viajes observados por tarjeta")
ax.set_ylabel("Porcentaje esperado de tarjetas unimodales")
ax.legend(frameon=False, loc="upper right")
style_axis(ax, grid_axis="y")
add_figure_title(fig, "Unimodalidad con igual numero de viajes", y=0.97)
fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.12, right=0.97, top=0.78, bottom=0.19)
plt.show()

print(
    "Conteos modales reconstruidos sin diferencia respecto del total: "
    f"{modal_count_audit == 0}."
)
print(
    "Mismo conjunto de tarjetas para k=3, 5 y 10: "
    f"n_viajes >= {MODAL_FIXED_MIN_TRIPS}."
)
```

### 7.4.2 Unimodalidad ajustada por OD principal

La diferencia a igual numero de viajes todavia puede reflejar que BIP y QR se
usan en territorios distintos. Como sensibilidad, asignamos a cada tarjeta su
OD dirigido mas frecuente y repetimos la comparacion con exactamente 10 viajes.
Conservamos solamente OD principales con al menos 100 tarjetas BIP y 100 QR;
el umbral se expresa en tarjetas porque esta prueba tiene unidad tarjeta, no
viaje.

Primero mantenemos la composicion observada de tarjetas dentro de esos OD.
Luego damos a ambos medios la misma ponderacion OD, definida por la cantidad
conjunta de tarjetas. Una reduccion de la brecha indicaria que la distribucion
territorial explica parte de la diferencia. Esta aproximacion solo controla el
OD principal: no iguala los demas recorridos, la oferta de transporte ni la
posible existencia de varias tarjetas por persona.

```{python}
#| label: block7-modal-fixed-trip-od-sensitivity
print("label: block7-modal-fixed-trip-od-sensitivity")

MODAL_OD_FIXED_SAMPLE_SIZE = 10
MODAL_OD_MIN_CARDS_PER_PAYMENT = 100

modal_card_od_counts_lf = modal_trip_od_lf.group_by(
    [
        "id_tarjeta",
        "payment_group",
        "origin_zone",
        "destination_zone",
    ]
).agg(pl.len().alias("n_trips_in_od"))

modal_card_main_od_lf = modal_card_od_counts_lf.group_by(
    ["id_tarjeta", "payment_group"]
).agg(
    [
        pl.col("origin_zone")
        .sort_by(
            [
                pl.col("n_trips_in_od"),
                pl.col("origin_zone"),
                pl.col("destination_zone"),
            ],
            descending=[True, False, False],
        )
        .first()
        .alias("origin_zone"),
        pl.col("destination_zone")
        .sort_by(
            [
                pl.col("n_trips_in_od"),
                pl.col("origin_zone"),
                pl.col("destination_zone"),
            ],
            descending=[True, False, False],
        )
        .first()
        .alias("destination_zone"),
    ]
)

modal_fixed_od_cards = (
    modal_fixed_k_long.filter(
        pl.col("sample_size") == MODAL_OD_FIXED_SAMPLE_SIZE
    )
    .select(
        [
            "id_tarjeta",
            "payment_group",
            "probability_unimodal",
        ]
    )
    .join(
        modal_card_main_od_lf.select(
            [
                "id_tarjeta",
                "payment_group",
                "origin_zone",
                "destination_zone",
            ]
        ),
        on=["id_tarjeta", "payment_group"],
        how="inner",
    )
    .collect()
)

modal_fixed_od_cells = modal_fixed_od_cards.group_by(
    ["origin_zone", "destination_zone", "payment_group"]
).agg(
    [
        pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
        pl.col("probability_unimodal")
        .mean()
        .alias("expected_share_unimodal"),
    ]
)

modal_fixed_od_bip = modal_fixed_od_cells.filter(
    pl.col("payment_group") == "BIP"
).select(
    [
        "origin_zone",
        "destination_zone",
        pl.col("n_cards").alias("n_cards_bip"),
        pl.col("expected_share_unimodal").alias("rate_bip"),
    ]
)
modal_fixed_od_qr = modal_fixed_od_cells.filter(
    pl.col("payment_group") == "QR"
).select(
    [
        "origin_zone",
        "destination_zone",
        pl.col("n_cards").alias("n_cards_qr"),
        pl.col("expected_share_unimodal").alias("rate_qr"),
    ]
)

modal_fixed_od_shared = (
    modal_fixed_od_bip.join(
        modal_fixed_od_qr,
        on=["origin_zone", "destination_zone"],
        how="inner",
    )
    .filter(
        (pl.col("n_cards_bip") >= MODAL_OD_MIN_CARDS_PER_PAYMENT)
        & (pl.col("n_cards_qr") >= MODAL_OD_MIN_CARDS_PER_PAYMENT)
    )
    .with_columns(
        (pl.col("n_cards_bip") + pl.col("n_cards_qr")).alias(
            "n_cards_pooled"
        )
    )
)

if modal_fixed_od_shared.is_empty():
    raise ValueError(
        "No hay OD principales con soporte suficiente en ambos medios."
    )

modal_fixed_base_counts = {
    row["payment_group"]: int(row["n_cards"])
    for row in modal_fixed_k_summary.filter(
        pl.col("sample_size") == MODAL_OD_FIXED_SAMPLE_SIZE
    ).iter_rows(named=True)
}
modal_fixed_od_raw = (
    modal_fixed_od_cards.group_by("payment_group")
    .agg(
        [
            pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
            pl.col("probability_unimodal")
            .mean()
            .alias("expected_share_unimodal"),
        ]
    )
)
modal_fixed_od_raw_metrics = {
    row["payment_group"]: row
    for row in modal_fixed_od_raw.iter_rows(named=True)
}

modal_fixed_od_shared_metrics = modal_fixed_od_shared.select(
    [
        pl.len().alias("n_od"),
        pl.col("n_cards_bip").sum().alias("n_cards_bip"),
        pl.col("n_cards_qr").sum().alias("n_cards_qr"),
        pl.col("n_cards_pooled").sum().alias("n_cards_pooled"),
        (
            (pl.col("n_cards_bip") * pl.col("rate_bip")).sum()
            / pl.col("n_cards_bip").sum()
        ).alias("observed_rate_bip"),
        (
            (pl.col("n_cards_qr") * pl.col("rate_qr")).sum()
            / pl.col("n_cards_qr").sum()
        ).alias("observed_rate_qr"),
    ]
).row(0, named=True)

modal_fixed_od_shared_weighted = modal_fixed_od_shared.with_columns(
    (
        pl.col("n_cards_pooled")
        / modal_fixed_od_shared_metrics["n_cards_pooled"]
    ).alias("common_od_weight")
)
modal_fixed_od_adjusted_rate_bip = modal_fixed_od_shared_weighted.select(
    (pl.col("common_od_weight") * pl.col("rate_bip")).sum()
).item()
modal_fixed_od_adjusted_rate_qr = modal_fixed_od_shared_weighted.select(
    (pl.col("common_od_weight") * pl.col("rate_qr")).sum()
).item()

modal_fixed_od_sensitivity = pl.DataFrame(
    {
        "comparison": [
            "Todos los OD principales validos",
            "OD compartidos, composicion propia",
            "OD compartidos, ponderacion comun",
        ],
        "n_od": [
            modal_fixed_od_cells.select(
                ["origin_zone", "destination_zone"]
            ).unique().height,
            modal_fixed_od_shared_metrics["n_od"],
            modal_fixed_od_shared_metrics["n_od"],
        ],
        "coverage_bip": [
            modal_fixed_od_raw_metrics["BIP"]["n_cards"]
            / modal_fixed_base_counts["BIP"],
            modal_fixed_od_shared_metrics["n_cards_bip"]
            / modal_fixed_base_counts["BIP"],
            modal_fixed_od_shared_metrics["n_cards_bip"]
            / modal_fixed_base_counts["BIP"],
        ],
        "coverage_qr": [
            modal_fixed_od_raw_metrics["QR"]["n_cards"]
            / modal_fixed_base_counts["QR"],
            modal_fixed_od_shared_metrics["n_cards_qr"]
            / modal_fixed_base_counts["QR"],
            modal_fixed_od_shared_metrics["n_cards_qr"]
            / modal_fixed_base_counts["QR"],
        ],
        "rate_bip": [
            modal_fixed_od_raw_metrics["BIP"][
                "expected_share_unimodal"
            ],
            modal_fixed_od_shared_metrics["observed_rate_bip"],
            modal_fixed_od_adjusted_rate_bip,
        ],
        "rate_qr": [
            modal_fixed_od_raw_metrics["QR"][
                "expected_share_unimodal"
            ],
            modal_fixed_od_shared_metrics["observed_rate_qr"],
            modal_fixed_od_adjusted_rate_qr,
        ],
    }
).with_columns(
    (100 * (pl.col("rate_qr") - pl.col("rate_bip"))).alias(
        "gap_qr_bip_pp"
    )
)

modal_fixed_od_display = (
    modal_fixed_od_sensitivity.rename(
        {
            "comparison": "comparacion",
            "n_od": "pares_od_principales",
            "coverage_bip": "cobertura_tarjetas_bip",
            "coverage_qr": "cobertura_tarjetas_qr",
            "rate_bip": "unimodales_bip",
            "rate_qr": "unimodales_qr",
            "gap_qr_bip_pp": "diferencia_qr_bip_pp",
        }
    ).to_pandas()
)

display(
    modal_fixed_od_display.style.hide(axis="index").format(
        {
            "pares_od_principales": fmt_int,
            "cobertura_tarjetas_bip": "{:.1%}",
            "cobertura_tarjetas_qr": "{:.1%}",
            "unimodales_bip": "{:.1%}",
            "unimodales_qr": "{:.1%}",
            "diferencia_qr_bip_pp": "{:+.1f}",
        }
    )
)

modal_fixed_od_plot_df = (
    modal_fixed_od_sensitivity.filter(
        pl.col("comparison").is_in(
            [
                "OD compartidos, composicion propia",
                "OD compartidos, ponderacion comun",
            ]
        )
    )
    .with_columns(
        pl.col("comparison")
        .replace_strict(
            {
                "OD compartidos, composicion propia": "Composicion propia",
                "OD compartidos, ponderacion comun": "Ponderacion comun",
            }
        )
        .alias("comparison_label")
    )
    .to_pandas()
)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8.8, 4.2))
x_positions = np.arange(len(modal_fixed_od_plot_df))
for payment_group, column in [("BIP", "rate_bip"), ("QR", "rate_qr")]:
    values = modal_fixed_od_plot_df[column].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    ax.plot(
        x_positions,
        values,
        marker="o",
        linewidth=2.0,
        markersize=7,
        color=PAYMENT_COLORS[payment_group],
        label=payment_group,
    )

ax.set_xticks(
    x_positions,
    modal_fixed_od_plot_df["comparison_label"],
)
ax.set_ylim(0, 0.70)
ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(PercentFormatter(1.0))
ax.set_xlabel("Comparacion dentro de los OD principales compartidos")
ax.set_ylabel("Porcentaje esperado de tarjetas unimodales")
ax.legend(
    frameon=False,
    loc="lower center",
    bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 1.02),
    ncol=2,
)
style_axis(ax, grid_axis="y")
add_figure_title(fig, "Unimodalidad ajustada por OD principal", y=0.97)
fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.12, right=0.97, top=0.72, bottom=0.19)
plt.show()

print(
    "OD principales retenidos: "
    f"{modal_fixed_od_shared_metrics['n_od']:,}; umbral: "

)
```

### 7.4.3 Sensibilidad al soporte minimo por OD principal

El resultado anterior retiene pocos OD y una fraccion reducida de las tarjetas.
Para comprobar que la lectura no dependa exclusivamente del umbral de 100,
repetimos la comparacion exigiendo 25, 50 y 100 tarjetas de cada medio por OD
principal. En cada nivel mostramos tanto la composicion observada dentro de los
OD retenidos como la ponderacion territorial comun.

```{python}
#| label: block7-modal-fixed-trip-od-threshold-sensitivity
print("label: block7-modal-fixed-trip-od-threshold-sensitivity")

MODAL_OD_CARD_THRESHOLDS = [25, 50, 100]

modal_fixed_od_pairs_all = (
    modal_fixed_od_bip.join(
        modal_fixed_od_qr,
        on=["origin_zone", "destination_zone"],
        how="inner",
    )
    .with_columns(
        (pl.col("n_cards_bip") + pl.col("n_cards_qr")).alias(
            "n_cards_pooled"
        )
    )
)

modal_fixed_od_threshold_rows = []
for min_cards in MODAL_OD_CARD_THRESHOLDS:
    retained = modal_fixed_od_pairs_all.filter(
        (pl.col("n_cards_bip") >= min_cards)
        & (pl.col("n_cards_qr") >= min_cards)
    )
    if retained.is_empty():
        continue

    retained_metrics = retained.select(
        [
            pl.len().alias("n_od"),
            pl.col("n_cards_bip").sum().alias("n_cards_bip"),
            pl.col("n_cards_qr").sum().alias("n_cards_qr"),
            pl.col("n_cards_pooled").sum().alias("n_cards_pooled"),
            (
                (pl.col("n_cards_bip") * pl.col("rate_bip")).sum()
                / pl.col("n_cards_bip").sum()
            ).alias("observed_rate_bip"),
            (
                (pl.col("n_cards_qr") * pl.col("rate_qr")).sum()
                / pl.col("n_cards_qr").sum()
            ).alias("observed_rate_qr"),
        ]
    ).row(0, named=True)

    retained_common = retained.with_columns(
        (
            pl.col("n_cards_pooled")
            / retained_metrics["n_cards_pooled"]
        ).alias("common_od_weight")
    )
    common_rate_bip = retained_common.select(
        (pl.col("common_od_weight") * pl.col("rate_bip")).sum()
    ).item()
    common_rate_qr = retained_common.select(
        (pl.col("common_od_weight") * pl.col("rate_qr")).sum()
    ).item()

    modal_fixed_od_threshold_rows.append(
        {
            "min_cards_per_payment": min_cards,
            "n_od": retained_metrics["n_od"],
            "coverage_bip": (
                retained_metrics["n_cards_bip"]
                / modal_fixed_base_counts["BIP"]
            ),
            "coverage_qr": (
                retained_metrics["n_cards_qr"]
                / modal_fixed_base_counts["QR"]
            ),
            "observed_rate_bip": retained_metrics[
                "observed_rate_bip"
            ],
            "observed_rate_qr": retained_metrics[
                "observed_rate_qr"
            ],
            "observed_gap_qr_bip_pp": 100
            * (
                retained_metrics["observed_rate_qr"]
                - retained_metrics["observed_rate_bip"]
            ),
            "common_rate_bip": common_rate_bip,
            "common_rate_qr": common_rate_qr,
            "common_gap_qr_bip_pp": 100
            * (common_rate_qr - common_rate_bip),
        }
    )

modal_fixed_od_threshold_sensitivity = pl.DataFrame(
    modal_fixed_od_threshold_rows
).sort("min_cards_per_payment")

modal_fixed_od_threshold_display = (
    modal_fixed_od_threshold_sensitivity.rename(
        {
            "min_cards_per_payment": "tarjetas_minimas_por_medio",
            "n_od": "pares_od_principales",
            "coverage_bip": "cobertura_tarjetas_bip",
            "coverage_qr": "cobertura_tarjetas_qr",
            "observed_rate_bip": "unimodales_bip_composicion_propia",
            "observed_rate_qr": "unimodales_qr_composicion_propia",
            "observed_gap_qr_bip_pp": "brecha_propia_qr_bip_pp",
            "common_rate_bip": "unimodales_bip_peso_comun",
            "common_rate_qr": "unimodales_qr_peso_comun",
            "common_gap_qr_bip_pp": "brecha_peso_comun_qr_bip_pp",
        }
    ).to_pandas()
)

display(
    modal_fixed_od_threshold_display.style.hide(axis="index").format(
        {
            "tarjetas_minimas_por_medio": fmt_int,
            "pares_od_principales": fmt_int,
            "cobertura_tarjetas_bip": "{:.1%}",
            "cobertura_tarjetas_qr": "{:.1%}",
            "unimodales_bip_composicion_propia": "{:.1%}",
            "unimodales_qr_composicion_propia": "{:.1%}",
            "brecha_propia_qr_bip_pp": "{:+.1f}",
            "unimodales_bip_peso_comun": "{:.1%}",
            "unimodales_qr_peso_comun": "{:.1%}",
            "brecha_peso_comun_qr_bip_pp": "{:+.1f}",
        }
    )
)

modal_fixed_od_threshold_plot = (
    modal_fixed_od_threshold_sensitivity.to_pandas()
)
threshold_x = modal_fixed_od_threshold_plot[
    "min_cards_per_payment"
].to_numpy()

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12.5, 4.2))

for payment_group, column in [
    ("BIP", "coverage_bip"),
    ("QR", "coverage_qr"),
]:
    axes[0].plot(
        threshold_x,
        modal_fixed_od_threshold_plot[column],
        marker="o",
        linewidth=2.0,
        markersize=6,
        color=PAYMENT_COLORS[payment_group],
        label=payment_group,
    )

axes[0].set_title("Cobertura retenida")
axes[0].set_xticks(threshold_x)
axes[0].set_ylim(0, 1)
axes[0].yaxis.set_major_formatter(PercentFormatter(1.0))
axes[0].set_xlabel("Tarjetas minimas por medio en cada OD principal")
axes[0].set_ylabel("Porcentaje de tarjetas")
axes[0].legend(frameon=False, loc="upper right")
style_axis(axes[0], grid_axis="y")

gap_specs = [
    (
        "observed_gap_qr_bip_pp",
        "Composicion propia",
        "#7A7F78",
    ),
    (
        "common_gap_qr_bip_pp",
        "Ponderacion OD comun",
        "#A66A3F",
    ),
]
for column, label, color in gap_specs:
    axes[1].plot(
        threshold_x,
        modal_fixed_od_threshold_plot[column],
        marker="o",
        linewidth=2.0,
        markersize=6,
        color=color,
        label=label,
    )

axes[1].axhline(0, color=NEUTRAL_LINE, linewidth=1.0)
axes[1].set_title("Brecha de unimodalidad")
axes[1].set_xticks(threshold_x)
axes[1].set_xlabel("Tarjetas minimas por medio en cada OD principal")
axes[1].set_ylabel("QR - BIP (puntos porcentuales)")

style_axis(axes[1], grid_axis="y")

add_figure_title(fig, "Sensibilidad al soporte minimo por OD principal", y=0.98)
fig.subplots_adjust(
    left=0.08,
    right=0.98,
    top=0.76,
    bottom=0.22,
    wspace=0.24,
)
plt.show()
```

## 7.5 Composicion modal y perfil semanal

Los bloques anteriores mostraron una diferencia pequena en el peso del fin de
semana y diferencias en la composicion modal. Aqui evaluamos si ambas lecturas
estan conectadas: comparamos BIP y QR dentro de tarjetas con el mismo modo
predominante.

Se consideran tres perfiles con predominio claro (al menos 50% de los viajes y
sin empate): solo bus, solo Metro/ferroviario y bus + Metro/ferroviario. Cada
tarjeta pesa lo mismo. El analisis describe asociaciones entre perfiles
observados; no identifica el motivo del viaje ni un efecto causal del medio de
pago.

### 7.5.1 Peso del fin de semana por perfil modal

La proporcion de fin de semana suma las participaciones ajustadas de sabado y
domingo calculadas en el bloque 6. Esto permite preguntar si QR mantiene una
mayor orientacion relativa al fin de semana dentro de cada perfil modal.

```{python}
#| label: block7-modal-weekend-share
print("label: block7-modal-weekend-share")

MODAL_WEEKLY_PROFILE_ORDER = [
    "Predominio solo bus",
    "Predominio solo Metro/ferroviario",
    "Predominio bus + Metro/ferroviario",
]
MODAL_WEEKLY_PROFILE_LABELS = {
    "Predominio solo bus": "Bus",
    "Predominio solo Metro/ferroviario": "Metro/ferroviario",
    "Predominio bus + Metro/ferroviario": "Bus + Metro/ferroviario",
}
MODAL_WEEKLY_PROFILE_ORDER_MAP = {
    profile: order
    for order, profile in enumerate(MODAL_WEEKLY_PROFILE_ORDER, start=1)
}

modal_weekly_cards = (
    modal_card_profile.select(
        ["id_tarjeta", "payment_group", "modal_dominance_type"]
    )
    .filter(
        pl.col("modal_dominance_type").is_in(
            MODAL_WEEKLY_PROFILE_ORDER
        )
    )
    .unique(subset=["id_tarjeta"])
    .collect()
)

modal_weekend_card_profile = (
    card_weekday_profile.select(
        [
            "id_tarjeta",
            "payment_group",
            "adjusted_share_weekday_6",
            "adjusted_share_weekday_7",
        ]
    )
    .join(
        modal_weekly_cards,
        on=["id_tarjeta", "payment_group"],
        how="inner",
    )
    .with_columns(
        (
            pl.col("adjusted_share_weekday_6")
            + pl.col("adjusted_share_weekday_7")
        ).alias("adjusted_weekend_share")
    )
)

modal_weekend_summary = (
    modal_weekend_card_profile.group_by(
        ["modal_dominance_type", "payment_group"]
    )
    .agg(
        [
            pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
            pl.col("adjusted_weekend_share")
            .mean()
            .alias("mean_adjusted_weekend_share"),
        ]
    )
    .with_columns(
        pl.col("modal_dominance_type")
        .replace_strict(MODAL_WEEKLY_PROFILE_ORDER_MAP)
        .cast(pl.Int8)
        .alias("profile_order")
    )
    .sort(["profile_order", "payment_group"])
)

modal_weekend_display = (
    modal_weekend_summary.select(
        [
            "modal_dominance_type",
            "payment_group",
            "n_cards",
            "mean_adjusted_weekend_share",
        ]
    )
    .rename(
        {
            "modal_dominance_type": "perfil_modal",
            "payment_group": "grupo_pago",
            "n_cards": "tarjetas",
            "mean_adjusted_weekend_share": "peso_fin_semana_ajustado",
        }
    )
    .to_pandas()
)

display(
    modal_weekend_display.style.hide(axis="index").format(
        {
            "tarjetas": fmt_int,
            "peso_fin_semana_ajustado": "{:.1%}",
        }
    )
)

modal_weekend_plot = modal_weekend_summary.to_pandas()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9.6, 4.5))
y_positions = np.arange(len(MODAL_WEEKLY_PROFILE_ORDER))[::-1]

for y_position, profile in zip(
    y_positions, MODAL_WEEKLY_PROFILE_ORDER
):
    subset = modal_weekend_plot.loc[
        modal_weekend_plot["modal_dominance_type"] == profile
    ].set_index("payment_group")
    values = {
        group: float(subset.loc[group, "mean_adjusted_weekend_share"])
        for group in PAYMENT_ORDER
    }
    ax.hlines(
        y_position,
        min(values.values()),
        max(values.values()),
        color=NEUTRAL_LINE,
        linewidth=3.5,
        zorder=1,
    )
    for group in PAYMENT_ORDER:
        ax.scatter(
            values[group],
            y_position,
            s=78,
            color=PAYMENT_COLORS[group],
            edgecolor="white",
            linewidth=1.0,
            zorder=2,
        )

ax.set_yticks(
    y_positions,
    [
        MODAL_WEEKLY_PROFILE_LABELS[profile]
        for profile in MODAL_WEEKLY_PROFILE_ORDER
    ],
)
ax.set_xlabel("Proporcion ajustada de viajes en sabado y domingo")
ax.set_ylabel("")
ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(PercentFormatter(1.0))
ax.set_xlim(
    0,
    max(
        0.25,
        float(modal_weekend_plot["mean_adjusted_weekend_share"].max())
        * 1.15,
    ),
)
ax.legend(
    handles=payment_legend_handles(78),
    loc="lower center",
    bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.30),
    ncol=2,
)
style_axis(ax, grid_axis="x")
add_figure_title(fig, "Peso del fin de semana dentro del perfil modal")
fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.25, right=0.96, top=0.78, bottom=0.25)
plt.show()
```
